On the front of the pile a map of Estonia is attached, a round seat plate and a wheel are leaned against the side, and at the end an object resembling a weapon built from transparent glass vessels from a chemistry lab, and at the very top a broom handle holding a wash basin.
157e039a05ee014d66a3aa2346808e824b088f4e: Luisa Greta Vilo is a photographic artist who graduated from the Pallas University of Applied Sciences. Vilo began exhibiting in 2020, when she participated in the joint exhibition of Estonian artists "Paus". Since then she has participated in several group exhibitions and created two solo exhibitions, "Loodu sees" [Inside the Created] at Aparaaditehas as part of the Open Culture Platform (in 2022) and "Haavatavuse fragmendid" [Fragments of Vulnerability] at Tampere House in Tartu (2023). Pallas has recognised Vilo with a field-specific scholarship in the arts direction.
b0ce64cbc1e6a63c236208416d1129060a9861f5: On a light background mottled in blue-brown, a black, irregular network dominates, onto which numerous irregular cuttings of colour prints with various images are glued. Some clearer images: in the middle left, a part of an engine; lower left, the surface of a stone and part of a tree trunk; lower right, a striped fabric slightly unrolled; middle right, part of a blue necklace against a background of brown cords; upper right, part of a coat sleeve and a light-coloured striped scarf; almost in the centre, part of a stone surface.
e88c43ee91b4adeb27132a2dd415bb93a0ea67a5: In the right-hand part of the picture, a group of three female figures: the right-hand one depicted from the neck to the knees, wearing a white summer dress with narrow shoulder straps. The middle woman, with yellow, red-speckled hair, is shown in profile, holding a white coffee cup. On the left, behind the middle figure, a third female figure modelled with colourful patches of colour, the facial area represented as a white patch. Behind the three figures in the foreground, another female figure with blue hair can be discerned. The background on the left is light blue.
5fa0fc20dc224df047e5ef351d3ae7429b0646bf: The video installation consists of two rooms separated by a wall. In the first, on a large screen, a video projection with an anxious soundtrack, alternating dim but realistic shots of an empty suburb devoid of people. In the second, a night-time suburb play model with two partially lit apartment buildings, lit streets, a flashing traffic light, an empty parking lot, a park area, and two screens projecting city views, recorded by webcams placed in various parts of the model and switching on in turn.
42c77da43534eff91764abf91cdbfeacc1619b00: Parents Priidu and Maria Hõisp. Childhood home at the Saare farm, Vanamõisa village, Pihtla parish. In 1915/16, as a gymnasium student evacuated to Danilov, he led the construction of the famous skating rink. In the spring/winter of 1920, he was put on trial for helping with smuggling near Lake Peipsi and sentenced to forced labour, but was released from punishment for bravery shown in the War of Independence and transferred to the reserve. ["Sakala" 21.04.1920.] At the beginning of World War II, he left for Argentina together with his wife and small daughter. He died there as a result of kidney disease.
1da026309431512e5b6929ef7ef4bc0bc6490f0a: According to his own words, Edward von Lõngus does not physically exist. There is only an idea. He is a jointly shared theoretical concept, a reflection of the era of multi-identity in the information field, generated from the vibrations of the collective consciousness. He was conceived in the fertile conditions of the information society through the coincidence of many different thoughts, and was born between the lines as a side effect of the 21st century. He is a collection of thoughts in a vast information field, spreading from consciousness to consciousness like a non-computer computer virus.
c02c10113b4c7d1478dc4315326101ca79925a30: In the middle, slightly shifted to the right, a three-quarter figure of a man in full-face view, shoulder-length, slightly wavy chestnut hair, moustache, small pointed beard, dark blue jumper, dark grey trousers. His right hand is slightly extended forward, thumb and index finger forming a ring. In the lower left corner, a three-quarter figure in a half-turn of a girl in a light lilac-blue dress, with a light-coloured head. Above, four male figures in various poses, wearing white shirts and brown trousers. The background in the lower part is in brownish-yellow tones.
bbca33aafb217d692231d53f420a098d58a4a3e7: An interior in brown tones with figures, as if overlaid with pink light. On a sofa with round end cushions, O. Maran sits on the left - wearing a brown, high-collared jumper, a lilac-red scarf, a grey coat. To his right, S. Liiberg in a spotted skirt and a blue blouse with frills, a crocheted woollen lace shawl on her shoulders. Behind the figures on the wall, O. Maran's seascape in a white frame, above the latter the edge of a picture in a dark frame. On the right, through a door ajar, a view opens into the darkness of an adjoining room.
692a8ed5f34fc605ad621e36f08b4f61f9f62af6: A multi-figure beach scene: on the headland, three net sheds, with a horse and cart and sketchily rendered groups of people. In the foreground in the middle, a group of beach women and fishermen taking fish out of a net. To their left three, in the right corner one boat with fishermen busying themselves nearby. Above the high-set horizon, a greenish-grey cloudy sky, and the sea in a darker tone with wave crests and strips of land reaching into the sea. Otherwise the body parts of the figures, painted as patches of colour, are outlined with a brown line.
3f22d009bf8a006427eaa823a0d483988620e80d: In the foreground, a summer hayfield: on the left, in the part not yet mown, reddish-brown cows and five white sheep are grazing; in the right-hand part, in front, hay is being carted by horse to an unfinished stack, behind it four finished stacks. At the edge of the hayfield in the middle, two tall trees; the field is bordered at the back and on the right by a row of green bushes. On the right edge, a patch of ploughed field is visible; in the background on the horizon, a number of farm buildings surrounded by trees and bushes. Above, the sky is in pale yellow and blue tones.
b59947a5e84a99a7972e45ad00e5a0c54042ec1a: On a thick tree trunk sits, in profile, a young blonde woman in North Estonian folk costume (blue-red-beige longitudinally striped skirt, white apron, blouse with blue embroidery, gold-embroidered pot-shaped cap), her head turned towards the viewer. Her right hand is on the back of a child, who leans against the woman from the other side of the trunk; with her left hand she holds the child's hand in her lap. The child is fair-haired, rosy-cheeked, wearing a white shirt, a wreath on its head. To the left of the figure, part of the trunk of a larger tree; on the right, climbing plants. On the horizon, in a bluish haze, the silhouette of Tallinn.
17f13ad2eab2f079582c0e6e87466044a2d7b07e: A snowy suburban street corner, viewed from slightly above. In the foreground, in front of a fence with large, built-up stone posts and a wrought-iron grille, a group of four women dressed in black moving to the right: on the left an old woman, in front of her two older ladies walking side by side, at the very front a young woman. At the street corner, on the intersecting street, an old woman dressed in black. In the background on the left a greenish-brown building, on the right the end façade of a single-storey house, in the middle ground on the left, in the golden section, a pine trunk. A rounded, soft, Art Nouveau treatment of form.
009d3d073f975dbc5204690e10e509af7a7e0182: Tõnis Jürgens (1989) is an artist, writer and cinema projectionist who works mainly in the forms of time-based media and installation. His video works combine essayism, poetic fragmentariness and the reuse of archival material, and are often expanded by scenographic spatial installations. Jürgens is currently studying in the EKA doctoral programme; in 2026 he will spend half a year in the WIELS residency in Brussels. Jürgens is a member of the Estonian Society of Photographic Artists and the Estonian Artists' Association.
1f831a71260c2843f7675bd471e5e774e677469e: Depicted larger than life, a still life of vegetables and garden produce in a large pinkish-red market bag, carried by a girl shown from the knees to the hips, moving to the left with a brisk stride, wearing a short green dress with unevenly placed red (and its shades) dots, fluttering in the wind. In the pile protruding from the bag: on the left radishes, onions, in the middle a cucumber, on the right tomatoes, potatoes, and behind them a section of a cabbage head, on the stump of which is the blue number 38. Beige-pink sky.
95b38ad24c32ff3a1f3bb21e446fc4842201c37a: Consists of two parts. A mystical artificial landscape in bluish-grey, brown tones with architectural motifs and draperies. On the left, against a night sky background with an orange glow, a pyramid-shaped object evenly covered with a falling drapery. Behind it, on the left and right, gateways with columns. In the foreground, brownish shadows falling on a bright open area, in front in the centre a dark, silky-glossy folded drapery. On the right, across the entire surface, a close-up view of parts of a building with columns, in the upper right corner a circular detail.
68280ab351ed150d292bcca032f4329254163b74: Against a sky background of rainbow-coloured horizontal, blending colour stripes (dark blue, red, yellow, light blue, green, pink) and in the middle ground in dark green water with yellowish-green patches, a green islet with rounded articulated forms stretching from the left edge of the painting almost to the right edge, with shrubbery in purplish-pink colour accents and a solitary tree. In the golden section on the right, in the foreground in the water, a slender tree with a thick trunk and lush crown. Pastose, textured painting technique.
0cc592b18ae87e2cd434ba859f82cf71f4331adb: Two male figures on a base, one of them, taller, has raised his right hand with a large palm upward, his left hand falling to the side, dressed in a work blouse with rolled-up sleeves, wearing long trousers and robust footwear. The other, shorter, bearded figure is dressed in a jacket and fig-leaf trousers [viigipüksid], is in a crouching position, stepping in the opposite direction from the worker, left leg bent at the knee, making a "hand-striking" gesture with the right hand. The base surface of the figures is a slightly sloping elevation. The composition is toned.
17ea540dd63b78cb41e8e56f9fe3bc8e0a1897fb: The sheet depicts a fresco placed among baroque architectural details, with a scene of men attacking unarmed shepherds with clubs and spears. On the left in the foreground, cattle, goats, sheep, herded by a naked bearded man with an animal hide on his shoulders and a boy. From the right, they are attacked by an athletically built man armed with a club. Before his feet lies a third shepherd, killed. From behind the attacker, four more men with spears are rushing out. In the foreground, a wooden barrel pushed on its side.
ce5b6a49bf57b6f391016efdfdb7729475077b30: Graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in painting, worked as a painting lecturer at the University of Tartu, the Estonian Academy of Arts and Sally Stuudio. From 2013 to 2019 he was the president of the Estonian Artists' Association, and afterwards, until 2025, its vice-president. Allsalu is a member of the board of the Estonian Painters' Association and of the councils of several art institutions. His works can be found in the collections of the Art Museum of Estonia, the Tartu Art Museum, the Bank of Estonia, AkzoNobel and the National Library of Estonia, as well as in private collections in Estonia and abroad.
806bce3146cc0f6c709eb103a4c913c884643e59: Katarina Meister (1990) graduated in 2016 from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a master's degree in painting, having previously obtained a bachelor's degree in the same field there. She spent her final academic year at the Helsinki Academy of Fine Arts, where she prepared her master's thesis. In 2011-2012 Meister studied at Central Saint Martins College of Art and Design in London. The artist has so far had four solo exhibitions and has participated in several group exhibitions in Estonia, the United Kingdom, Spain and Lithuania.
91415407ce2410b2f7549a599830a014d393b11b: Henri Hütt (1985) has obtained a bachelor's degree from the Department of Performing Arts of the Viljandi Culture Academy of the University of Tartu, and a master's degree in performance art from the Faculty of Fine Arts of the Estonian Academy of Arts. Hütt values creative hybrid forms, which include performance art forms with a technological dominant, performative installations, sound performances, the concept of the staged exhibition, and much more that is elusive. Henri Hütt is also a member of the group MIMproject.
e93ee4d35e05eb2d5b80090e40bdbb117b7cf73b: Henrik Rakitin (b. 1993) is a multidisciplinary artist whose work is closely tied to the observation of and commentary on contemporary capitalist culture, describing this culture and playing with it. When viewing his own created works, he himself often uses the concept of the "Stockholm syndrome" – at first it feels pleasant and the sugar stimulates the brain, but on the other hand an agonising aspect is added, imprisonment and nihilism, which can result in a compulsive overdose of meanings and ideas.
aa40ca41183ae0575610e35346d8e525cd07972a: In the foreground, on the central axis, spanning the entire height of the composition, the figure of a young woman dancing in a green sleeveless dress, a sheaf of grain on her head, her body in half-profile to the right, gaze directed towards the viewer. Her right hand, with a hanging palm, directed towards the viewer, her left extended to the right. In the middle ground, on either side of the figure, groups of three people and two red agricultural machines. On the horizon, the sea, the ground light brown, the sky whitish-pink. Painting manner with hazy contours and soft treatment of form.
e4cde0c40d09c3877b1c93db70759b83ee9339c4: Comrade Kalinin, wearing glasses, at a younger age, with "ИСКРА" in his left hand, in an industrial room behind a workbench, surrounded by co-workers listening to him, three of whom are sitting in the foreground. To the right of them, at the edge of the picture, a lone standing worker. Further back in the industrial room, two workers moving in opposite directions, one of them bare-bodied seen clearly, the other in his shirt pulling something with a rope over his shoulder. In the foreground on the left, a table with tools in front of the workbench. In the left wall, behind the groups of people, a window can be seen.
ae8e4c139e41ed27b3df17f96cebc826c1045b5d: A crowded city square seen from above. In the centre of the square a green square [skväär] with benches, surrounded by lamp posts and grey advertisement pillars. Behind the square a large public building decorated with columns and sculptures. On the right in the foreground, the corner of a grey stone house. On the left, in the more illuminated part, a street lined with houses and trees disappearing behind the corner of the public building. Lower left, soldiers with an aerostat surrounded by a crowd. Above, a blue sky in which aerostats are flying.
4fcbedee8a33a81955de5f0df1b7e160cb960f23: Sirje Eelma's (b. 1950 in Tallinn) main source of art is nature. For her, the printmaking process of graphic art and the nuances arising from the internal possibilities of the means of expression are important. The subdued colouring brings out well the inner glow of the work and the contrasts of different textures. References to recognisable motifs are intertwined with an elegant formal language, the mysterious technical multilayeredness of the images creates playful spatial associations and holds together a positive mood.
34ebf335adcc12ec0cbccaa813122a11a96e9f0b: Laurene Bois-Mariage (b. 1981 in France) is a French artist who currently lives and works in both Estonia and Finland. She obtained her initial higher education in fine arts as well as a later master's degree at the l'Ecole Nationale Supérieure de la Photographie in Arles. Since then, Laurene has been developing her creative path mainly through the medium of photography, while expanding the possibilities offered by photography through the worlds of sculpture and installation.
ff7c8df4281c469c0bdc5f71edef12523ca312a9: A backyard in the old town, densely surrounded by houses: on the left and right, low grey houses, on the left a wooden staircase leads under the roof, the lower part of the house on the right, with several doors and a tall chimney, turns into a taller building with a red roof, white-plastered walls and shutters. In the background, a three-storey house with a grey roof and a slightly taller house with a reddish-brown roof. From under the latter's gateway/passage light is showing. On the right, in the corner of the yard, a small tree, at the upper edge a tin-grey sky. Painted in a pastose manner.
65318ca3fc442e3139dd01c1140b4b680397a204: A three-figure group against the background of a landscape with bays, a river mouth, and canals seen from above. In front, in the centre, a three-quarter figure of a naked woman symbolising the Earth, seen frontally, her hands on the shoulder and neck of two young men standing beside her, seen in profile. The man on the left has his head upright, hands crossed on his stomach, the one on the right has his head lowered, hands behind his back. The treatment of the figures is conventional/stylised. Above the heads, a pinkish glowing sky with solitary luminous clouds. In the painting, a uniformly pale bluish, light greenish colouring.
4598aff16ba41256d500c746175a5ca33c691263: In the foreground, foaming waves whose crests have gathered into the shapes of water nymphs and water-horses. From the waves rises in the middle a steep cliff peak, descending as a coastal cliff to the right edge of the picture. From the cliff, a naked woman with long blond hair fluttering is descending into the water, where a lyre has already fallen from her hand. On the right, on the cliff face, a group of monks in torchlight, with crucifixes and incense vessels. The oldest of them raises a cross towards Lorelei. At the right edge, one monk has sunk into the waves, in the embrace of a water nymph.
dd4813fa4baf2a78cffbf6d8395fb52f4d4139fb: On the left, a turquoise-blue river and a small ship with a tall smoking chimney sailing towards the Seine. On the right, the embankment of the Seine: in the foreground in the centre sits a man on the embankment parapet, his back to the viewer, wearing a dark green coat and a black hat. On the right, large trees and figures among them functioning as staffage. The embankment is covered with sunspots breaking through the foliage of the trees. In the middle ground, a bridge with three arches and large houses on the other bank. Through the treetops a greenish-yellow sky is visible.
36da19f060a48feb90fdae193dac9a87452b9d49: Heleliis Hõim is an interdisciplinary artist who works in parallel in different media. She has done several collaborative projects and solo exhibitions in Estonia, and has furthered her studies, alongside her MA studies in contemporary art at the Estonian Academy of Arts, at the Art Academy of Latvia and at the Accademia di Belle Arti di Milano in Italy. She has also participated in international group exhibitions and art residencies such as "NordArt'23", "Biennale Larnaca", "La Wayaka" in Panama and "Policlinica '20" in Ukraine.
bb01b62399c785470e91a45eb1c319168817376f: Under a round-arched and striped vault, on the right of the picture, an old royal couple and young people are seated. The king's son stands and a maiden sits. The old royal couple are in folk costume. The queen has on her head a red cap with green trim, a brooch on her breast, a striped skirt, a white apron, and a kerchief around her neck. The king wears a long coat tied with a striped belt, and a crown on his head. The maiden has a striped skirt, a wreath on her head, and beads around her neck. The king's son has a crown on his head, a striped shawl thrown over his shoulder, and holds the maiden by the hand.
e5b84f22134980cb1bc7e3b79dab6277786f6a72: In the foreground, centre, a half-length portrait of the art historian Mai Levin; she wears a light blouse and holds a light-blue shawl in her hands, raised to her chest. Her head is turned slightly to the left, her chin raised, and bright light falls on the right side of her face. Behind the figure, in the background, leaning columns, on the right part of an arcade, on the left an antique column with a capital and a headless antique sculpture. In the background on the left, a group of people in colourful clothing walking towards the ruins of an antique temple on the horizon. Light, pastel colour range.
c5484dfcffa3a7858cf23a79cffcde33e998d33c: On a black background, in the centre, a young woman in a long white dress kneels on the ground in profile facing right, her arms stretched out straight and parallel in front of her. In front of her, in three-quarter profile facing left, stands a young woman in a long white dress that flares slightly at the bottom, wearing a strange wide headdress on her head, holding in her left hand a long, thin, diagonal stick. In front of the woman, on the right, a dog-like creature sits on the ground in profile facing right, its head turned towards the viewer. From the upper right a bird flies down. White lines on the image, a crescent moon in three places.
68a881ff6ab61e4015f5daded7e8afc3f5c9c4ba: Katrin Piile (1987) is a painter, performance artist and draughtsman who graduated in painting from the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2010, has been exhibiting since 2006, and works within the ranks of Metropol, one of the most distinctive phenomena of the Estonian art scene, an artists' commune. Katrin Piile's paintings and drawings are characterised by a painterly and emotional trickster-type hyperrealism, precision in detail, a large volume of work, and a certain dramatic quality that can be associated with the influences of comic culture.
39b59ff5d076c16d3ee0c142b60ba912a4b842eb: A painting in vivid tones in a cubist style, with two generalised figures in the central part. The left-hand figure has a hat covering the eyes, a white glove in the hand. The right-hand figure has short hair, a garment with a turquoise-blue tinge on the shoulders. In the foreground a brownish abstract form, on which is a bluish fruit basket, a goblet-like object, a pile of documents, and a brown-coloured glove. In the process of painting, patterns and shapes have been scraped into the paint. The places marking the outlines of the images are slightly impasto.
b589eb85a87d9fdd23969ed2673bcb4994d65ccb: Four mensurae with foetuses of children can be seen, a fifth, in the left edge, can be seen partially. The first vessel from the right is the lowest. It contains a contracted foetus of a child. Next to it, a second, slightly taller vessel, in which a whole foetus is visible. In the third, even larger vessel, the foetus has a square incision made in the abdominal area, revealing the internal organs. The arms and legs are truncated. The leftmost is the tallest vessel. The foetus in it has an incision made in the lower part of the body.
825fbf48df44afbecb809d5c94875cbec6c458a0: A colourful composition, dynamically growing upwards, of women's faces. Each face captures a different nuance of mood and expression. The modelling of the faces relies mainly on the possibilities of light and shadow. The whole colour range is intense, in the area of the faces the colours melt into one another at times, giving the impression of a more glazed surface, in contrast to the restless remainder of the surface. The whole composition, growing upwards with tension, is placed on a greyish-blue background, with two pink wheels at the top.
07e1e2611f32a07ecc19eca5aeaf27749d03bae5: In the foreground of a park, two children playing: the left-hand one on the ground on all fours, facing right, where a second child, without clothes, sits in profile facing right on top of a sand heap, its head turned over the shoulder to the left. Behind them, in the centre, two women conversing on a bench: the left-hand one sits with her back turned, her head turned to the right, where a woman sits facing forward, with legs stretched out in front, hands at her sides, leaning on the bench, her head turned in profile to the left; both wear kerchiefs on their heads. On the left of the sheet a tree trunk, in the distance silhouettes of trees.
ce2c8ea2e5d552d690b5f4cd8f436f73f7243a7c: In the foreground five human figures: the man standing in the centre wears a small hat-like cap on his head, a brown coat on his shoulders, and the curved palm of his left hand is raised to the level of his white shirt's chest. Behind the man standing in the foreground is a fair-haired young man in a greenish coat; between the men are two women dressed in light clothing with white headscarves, one of them in profile. In the right edge a woman adjusting a blue hood. In the background a hilly panoramic landscape. Angular forms, the colour scheme mainly pinkish-brown and blue.
6695fe8efbb39ed431b70e8ef58fb66e8c3f529d: In the lower left corner an arched bridge, in front of which cranes and two yellow sand heaps, in the distance the silhouette of a city. On the right a concrete-edged embankment parapet, a path that ends in the distance at a round garden pavilion. On both sides of the path a row of trees (bare). On the right a triangular sloping surface, behind which a dark green dome. The sky is light blue, glowing yellow in the upper left corner. The crowns of the trees, the sand heaps, and the path are painted impasto, with a thick layer of paint, the overall colour range delicate and transparent.
e1ead1585576ce5206964734d7b117c9c3af979e: Against a background of ruins, four adults and three children sit side by side facing the viewer: from the left, a woman in a black coat with a hat, a bundle under her arm; a woman in a light coat, brown skirt and headscarf, hands in her lap. In the centre a young woman with a red hat in light-coloured clothing, a child in her arms on her knees; a girl stands barefoot, her coat flaps open; a man in half-profile, bareheaded, in house slippers, a coat over his shoulders, behind him the figure of a boy. In front of the people, piles of kitchen utensils, cups, a heeled shoe, a bucket with things in it.
ac5dfb24b7c945dab01789d6815d1e90a2c086bf: Born in Riga as the son of a merchant. Studied at the Dresden Academy of Arts. After a study trip to Italy, where he associated with B. Thorwaldsen and J. A. Koch, he returned to Riga in 1829. In 1832 he moved to Dresden, where, after a second trip to Italy, he became a lecturer at the academy in 1843 and a professor in 1846. Towards the end of his life he engaged in scholarship (the history of Livonia, natural sciences, etc.). In 1836 he painted a portrait of C. D. Friedrich, in 1833 the altarpiece of Riga Cathedral and other altarpieces for churches in Latvia. He was a prolific portraitist.
093bc025ab36fcf696b622284c6416ee9fbfdc47: By a body of water, three white horses, two of them with riders on their backs, one held by the bridle by a naked male figure. A fourth white horse with a naked rider stands in the water. On the right bank, a dark-haired naked woman sits on a white cloth, and a white dog with brown spots lies. In the upper right corner, trees and bushes given as generalised masses, above a cloudy sky. Both the bodies of the people and of the horses are modelled in detail with the help of light and shadow. Greenish-grey and yellowish-brown colour tones.
b691bdbf6b34a8c1265cee7925b2f495965263cf: A young woman sitting on a chair in half-profile, her head turned towards the viewer, her gaze directed downward. The woman has short light-brown hair, a yellowish cap on her head. Her left hand rests on the back of the chair, the right in her lap. The right leg is stretched forward, the left bent at the knee. The woman wears a pinkish-red buttoned jacket, and long dark-blue puffed trousers. Behind her, in the interior on the right along the wall, pictures. The model's face and hands are modelled softly, the clothing and background painted with broad, sweeping strokes.
d89ac7b451ddad695ae549f4c3b7ca9cc72af010: Two headless mannequins standing side by side, wearing white men's shirts. In the background shadows of trees. In the foreground a white box with red lettering "How to Host a Murder", with colourful oriental figurines on it and two grey cylindrical closed vessels. At the top left small white text: "dead men tell no tales". Below it: "How to Host a Murder". Above the left mannequin: "Angus Mapple", above the right one: "Bracha Lisson". In the lower right corner: "Carbonary Pictures presents" with a logo and the text: "While Away Films"
6d2dc2be1ea589340d0d7ae1bb14f3c412bfd1a6: An audiobook chapter from Holger Kaints' book "Lennukivaatleja" (2009), which describes the actions of a reclusive first-person narrator, alienated from post-independence society, in the Soodevahe garden town, where he spends his time watching the air traffic at Tallinn Airport and developing related conspiracy theories. The background is the story of the distribution of garden plots to factory workers and the emergence of the Soodevahe gardening cooperative. The audiobook is read by Rasmus Kaljujärv. Recording by Timo Toots.
8c1eab5eaf10e65eeddd0c7a50d751e305a408fa: In the centre of the sheet a large snowball, beneath which a shape resembling a person's back and right hand. Below right, in profile facing left, a woman's portrait figure, her head in three-quarter profile facing left. Below left, behind the depiction of the back of a person in the foreground, the half-figure of a man looking out. In the centre left, in profile facing left, a woman's figure standing on her left leg, right leg stretched straight forward, arms crossed on the chest, head in frontal view. Inside the snowball, upper right, the legs of a person in long trousers.
7ae3adbf99f191647945421798164faf3dbea4a0: On the sheet a fresco, surrounded by architectural ornamentation. The picture depicts a fierce battle scene - presumably the attack of the Sabines, who have come to take revenge, upon the Romans. On the left in front, a bearded man has pinned his opponent on his back and raises a dagger to kill him. In the foreground a blonde woman, a small child on her arm, trying to stop an armoured man with a shield who wants to kill with a sword a fallen athletic man. In the foreground on the ground, a man's head separated from the body, a shield, a spear, and swords.
76a37e34a4040c8cc1326d39609903497b89c1bd: In the middle an old lime tree with two branches, the right branch first bends down, then rises. On the left in front a pole fence. From the front a rail track runs backward, which further back forks into two. At the back a yard enclosed by a pole fence is visible, where a high thatched saddle roof and an old lime tree next to the building. In the middle and on the right on the horizon young forest. On the right a low grass-covered brook, on the bank a boy sits, wearing a peaked cap, a red waistcoat, beige trousers, a stick in his hand. In the shallow water of the brook two cows are drinking.
599dc25f3d4d4f8494a775e28717c9935bb5df30: 1993-1997 studied painting at the Tallinn Art University. Solo exhibitions 1996 Muu-ry gallery in Helsinki; 1997 Mustpeade Maja Gallery, Tallinn; 1998 Tallinn Art Salon; 1999 together with Toomas Tõnissoo in Cork, Ireland; 1999 Tallinn City Gallery with T. T.; 2001 Tartu Art Museum with T. T.; 2002 Rakvere Gallery with T. T.; 2003 Hobusepea Gallery with T. T.; 2004 Maison de la Baie in Vains, France with T. T.; 2005 Vaal Gallery with T. T.; 2006 Koguva Art Gallery.
867747582e862ab553d124616a6cd3aaba639123: Helena Lepik, (b. 1994) is a freelance painter who lives and works in Tallinn. She studied at the Estonian Academy of Arts, Faculty of Fine Arts, BA in Painting (2017). Her work is directed towards the problematics of psychological self-search, sexuality and the determination of identity, as well as themes related to the soul's journey arising from death. She prefers to work in the format of large flat painting, paying attention to a forceful sense of form and colour.
35544bbd6d9d92b1fd1a5f995346dd40e5663efe: In a room, which opens through an arched opening into another, larger room, on the left in front stands the Bailiff of Turku in a long coat, in a garment with a high collar, and shakes the hand of the envoy of the Estonians. The envoy has long, straight-cut, fair hair, a band around his head, a sword at his belt, sandals on his feet. Another Estonian stands on the right, holding a scroll in his hand. Next to him stands an old man in a monk's robe. On the right in front the corner of an iron-bound chest. Behind, in the larger room, warriors with spears. In the back wall two tall window openings with round quadrants.
6efabd4bb270b2b4cf9bdaf23d3d5bd89871f7dd: Full portrait - Portrait of a young woman sitting in upright format, in profile view, face turned toward the viewer. A blonde lady in a blue-patterned dress on a white ground. In the foreground the right hand rests on the corner of the chair seat, further back the left hand in the lap. Composition: the sitter sits facing the right side of the picture, the knees and legs extending beyond the picture frame. 2/3 of the painting's background is reddish pink, the lower part a warm green tone. The chair is reddish brown. Painted in a glazing, decorative, laconic style.
66b0f75b874c5fcfc344d1373d5c3aaf1447ff7e: Tarmo Roosimölder (1970) studied geology at the University of Tartu, but as a painter and graphic artist he is self-taught, having, among other things, furthered his skills in Tõnis Laanemaa's drawing studio. His "style" has developed under the combined influence of desert trips in his school years and the native seacoast, where the small human meets great nature. Roosimölder has participated in exhibitions both in Estonia and elsewhere, and his works are in many private collections. He is a member of the Estonian Association of Independent Graphic Artists and the Estonian Artists' Association.
ccebdef89a786da8cdca7f0cdc8e43b9fc586300: A panoramic landscape mainly in bluish-green, purplish-red and black tones: in the foreground in the lower left corner the upper body of a man in a hat, given in black, back to the viewer, a stick in hand. Further back a bay inlet with ships and a fishing village densely packed with houses. Above, tall pointed mountains painted with broad, open brushstrokes, between whose peaks a greenish-blue sky is visible. In the upper part of the painting the ground is at places left uncovered by the paint layer, at places the paint layer is impasto.
575515411ffe44356568ae4c5908d05e1e2d4d5f: In the left two-thirds of the composition, viewed from above, filling the entire given surface, a group of soldiers (upper bodies) painted in greenish-brown with bouquets of flowers in their hands. On the lower right, back to the viewer, the head of a woman in a black veil. In the right third, against a black background broken up with whitish-grey surfaces, in the lower corner the profile of a woman in a black mourning veil (facing left), with a red carnation in hands raised to the chest. In the upper right edge a fragment of a grey urn in a black niche.
5e93ce9be9b77f3349da30791b3b919b01c7b0d4: A two-part composition of five female nudes against a greyish-green background with black and dark red patches. In the foreground of the left part a female figure stretching-stepping across the picture surface, as if knee-deep in water, bent arms above the head thrown back onto the nape. In the right part a female figure kneeling, holding something heavy above the head. Further back three figures in different poses, light-toned vertical lines in the background between the figures. Painted with a broad brush in a forceful, expressive manner.
a5c2a40b9dd307cfc9f98ada18f887fc53661b05: Bust portrait of a young man. Body in frontal view, face in three-quarter turn to the right. The young man has longer hair, sideburns, a nose with a narrow hump, and a small moustache. He wears a uniform with large gold-fringed epaulettes, from under whose embroidered high collar a dark scarf is visible. On the neck, on ribbons, two orders, one of which is the Cross of St. George. To their left an order entirely covered with precious stones. On the right side of the chest medals: the first за въру і въркость, the second за службу и храбростъ.
f5dfe7bee4e356900b8b99b17f6ed3ad4e4e2637: painter, graphic artist, ex libris artist and poster artist Lev Vassiljev was born in Tula, Russia, into an engineer's family. After studying at the Moscow Art School he moved in 1950 to Tallinn, where he studied sculpture at ERKI (EKA), his teachers being Enn Roos, Aleksander Kaasik and Martin Saks. He also worked as a graphic artist (etching and aquatint), made collages and assemblages. Among his works there are pieces of political tone, while at the same time the artist was fond of mythology and literary themes
b23a9896127ced3994251258ce224d852782861c: A spacious room filled with a few pieces of furniture and figures. In the front edge, behind a light-coloured table, sit figures in brown and dirty yellow tones. To their left, in the lower corner, a wine-red sofa with cylindrical end cushions, a pink cushion in the middle. In the back wall of the room, in a brown niche, a light brown bed with tall ends, in which a pink person lies under a yellow blanket. From a doorway next to the niche there is a view into an adjacent room. The walls of the rooms are red in different tones.
2094cf189b028ac7486d2c8ce8b2f938bfb95b11: Laura Talvet (b. 1981) is an artist living and working in Tallinn. She has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts, Department of Fine Arts, BA in Painting (2019), and has participated in several group exhibitions in Estonia. For her BA thesis work "Merd vaadates muutud ise selleks" (2019, supervisor Mihkel Ilus) Talvet was awarded the EKA Young Artist Prize. She currently works as a freelance artist, whose main creative fields are painting, mixed media and photography.
d5b267b4aadec11d79a82655a40cc22913d7334f: A headless female figure with platform shoes with textile uppers. The body is covered with brown textile wrapped in strips (strips of dyed net curtain), onto which strips of gummed textile measuring tape (ready-made) are glued, dividing the body, arms and legs into parts, like a carcass of meat (in butcher shops of the time pictures of cattle and pigs hung on the walls divided in this way into parts of different culinary value); onto the body measurements are applied in white paint and numbers cut from wrapping paper are glued on
2d48002ef13d15735f43c1d5a20bab3a43e64384: An ultramarine blue expanse of water rising diagonally to the left, with bright and black ripples, with a golden boat, oars in the water, casting a shadow forward. In the foreground on the left a standing long-haired female nude in frontal view, with the raised left hand holding a golden scythe by the cutting blade. To the right of the boat a standing female nude in frontal view, raised hands on the nape. The water is bordered from above by a bright yellowish-orange glow with a jagged upper edge, above which a blue expanse, black at the upper edge, with dimly discernible golden letters.
24ac45aab05af1a62691b43765078c71e95bbfbf: "Eternal Fire" is a staged documentary film about love for propagated role models. A girl raised in the Soviet spirit is taught to respect heroes, reminders of whom in the form of bronze sculptures filled our whole town. But the girl's faith in the ideal finds expression in love for a sacred image. For a girl who grew up in the era of the Soviet atheist state order, this is the Bronze Soldier of Tõnismägi. But the soldier is unable to bear the embodiment of Eternal Love...
93d4bced7d5032f79dbe35eccd8e6084328a5703: View from Kadriorg to Suhkrumägi and Marienberg (Maarjamäe). In the foreground a low sandy shore with large stones. On the right in front a peasant man sits on a stone smoking a pipe. Along the shore a rail track leads around the bay bend up to Marienberg. In front in the middle on the beach a bench and a wrecked boat, on which at the back the clothes of bathers. On the left at the back on a hillock the buildings of Marienberg manor. Before Marienberg a long bathing bridge on piles leads to the bathhouse. On the right at the back the steep bank of Suhkrumägi, in front of which meadow land.
7317e251cb40593270b379c7558c89429f30f0f2: Liivia Leškin (1956) has long been engaged in fashion and textile art, but in the last decade increasingly also in painting. Her abstract painting work is characterised by confident gestures and the courage to remain true to intuition. Leškin has graduated from ERKI in fashion design and worked there for a long time also as a lecturer and professor of the fashion department; she has actively participated in art life and exhibitions both in Estonia and internationally. She is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association.
b02fa27c6d0426fc337522191f2ec5e4a1edbc5c: Pen drawings for A. Chekhov's collection of short stories "Kingsepp ja paharet" (1923) and illustrations for E. Bornhöhe's "Kuulsuse narrid" (1941); costume designs for B. Mussorgsky's opera "Boris Godunov" (1930), G. Puccini's opera "Turandot" (1939), C. Nielsen's ballet "Lakšmi" (1937), R. Glière's ballet "The Red Poppy" (1939) and E. Tubin's ballet "Kratt" (1944), as well as costume and set designs for W. A. Mozart's "Don Juan" (1952) and A. Kivi's play "Nõmmekingsepad" (1960)
b72be59b7d097d4a8feaf009da61d7381b1db3fc: On the left part of the composition, on a red horse covered with a green cloth over the croup, a girl in a yellow shirt and orange short trousers, with flowing hair, riding toward the viewer on the right. In front and to the left, dark blue abstract barriers, single nasturtium leaves. In the right part, in front of dark blue abstract barriers, a red horse with flowing mane in three-quarter profile to the right, head in three-quarter profile to the left. At the top, a freely undulating rainbow spans the whole composition. Light blue background.
018f1ca8f8fca74afd964ca9da4e5b93a477506b: A deserted landscape motif in yellow evening light: in the centre a yellow house with several gables and a brown roof, resting on a high foundation built of limestone, higher on the right. From the lower left corner an asphalt-covered road and pavement curve into the depth of the picture. Along the road on the left a lantern with a white shade on a post, grass and bushes. To the right of the road in the foreground a large, multi-branched bare tree, further back a grassy ditch bank, a sandy slope and a pine forest. Above, a pale blue sky.
d5886e4aef9b09829126bd87ad3c4f300a21ad16: In the foreground a grain field with six rye reapers: five women in white Hiiumaa folk costumes with red headwear, on the left a man with a hat. Behind, a stone wall borders the field and a road leads to the village. In the middle part of the picture, between large trees, a two-storey white building with a hipped roof, to its left a smaller house and a well with a sweep, behind which a church with a sharp spire is visible. About 2/3 of the painting's surface is a high, cumulus, pre-thunderstorm sky, bright patches of light falling on the rye reapers.
c3f3b317ca78745127c22bf23b52332a304a2f23: A composition in grey and brown tones, with a city wall of reddish-brown stones along the horizontal central axis. On the right edge, in the middle, five smallish men are occupied with carrying and laying stones. Behind the wall, old-town houses, towers and churches of dark grey limestone. In the lower corner of the composition, in front of the city wall, four men (one of them with a yellow turban, another with berets) are listening to a man in an ochre-coloured robe with a red headband, gesturing with his raised right hand.
4f978c363426f472c8a9a0b3f60802ff88e4ea2f: On a small round table covered with a pinkish-red cloth, a large round brown vase with bright orange-yellow marigolds occupies the central place. To the right of the vase two yellowish-toned little boxes, to the left a small silver footed container. In the background, on a brown wall, three paintings hang. The two lower ones are almost entirely hidden by the flower bouquet, the middle one above depicts a white horse with a rider. In the lower right corner, the backrest of a large chair with green upholstery is visible, along with a bit of the armrest.
ca51486682bfb851d80c5c973d0b24ed4ce7ed1d: In the foreground on the right, a woman sitting in a dark sleeveless dress and a white headscarf, with a child in a light shirt on her lap. Behind her, a woman standing in a brown skirt and blouse and a white scarf, her outstretched hand resting on a rake handle. In front of the women, in the centre foreground, a jug, a basket and other household items. In the middle ground two women in skirts and blouses and two men in hats, rakes and forks on their shoulders, walking. On the right edge a brown horse, the sky pinkish-brown.
cb56d31f34e3a9edfde6812ca3c83cd15867eb09: An abstract composition of various geometric surfaces: on the horizontal central axis a red and pink stripe, from which red and yellow stripes descend to the left. On the stripes, surfaces bordered by a blue stripe, striped red-yellow inside with blue spots. In the upper right corner, an Indian in profile with a red headband, to his left a reddish spot within a large grey spot. Below on the right a quadrangular figure filled inside with labyrinth lines.
743764c070e36432a37492d9e866d0ca61dbc770: A topographically beautiful, detailed view of the Narva river with two fortresses, one on each side of the river. In the foreground a group of figures consisting of five men and a small girl dressed in white. On the riverbank in the foreground, wooden houses, enclosures, animals and bushes. Groups of trees on the left and right edges. On the skyline, to the left and right of the fortress buildings, small houses scattered in the landscape. Above, a blue sky with grey cloud streaks and white cloud masses.
38a806ed297d315d46025230f8693e97fc27e875: Bust of a young man (portrait bust, 2/3 of the upper body in frontal view, head turned 1/4 to the right). A round, strong-willed face, hair combed straight over the head. Low brow ridge, short straight nose, narrow lips, strong angular chin. Dress shirt with folded collar corners, bow tie, dress waistcoat and wide tailcoat lapels. The shoulders pass into the upper part of the sleeves, about 10 cm long. Painted to resemble bronze, the lower paint layer green, the upper dark brown. High-quality thin plaster cast, hollow inside.
35c43deca98d93fa7de01d62f1af0d46c32e4c87: Studied painting in Vienna and Rome. From 1820 worked in Petersburg and from 1849 in Tallinn as a portraitist and drawing teacher. Also created portraits of Estonians and 8 volumes of lithographic portraits of Russian statesmen, scholars and artists ("Les contemporains", from 1822, Russian-language edition 1828) in the spirit of early realism, i.e. Biedermeier realism (collection of articles "Four Baltic German Artists", Tallinn 1994, exhibition catalogue "Russian Rulers", Tallinn 2006)
c53ef599e2ce42e232d76cc9190218cde35c1e24: An electronic three-dimensional work, an upright rectangular parallelepiped-shaped wooden body painted blue (Berlin blue), on the front of which, at the top, are humming lamps: three lamps with alternating numbers. Below the number lamps is a diamond-shaped cluster of 24 blue electric lamps. An electronic chime sounds from within the body (F. Liszt, "Liebesträume"). Inside the body an electric motor, relays, electronics (3 square-wave generators, transistor circuits, microcircuits)
07c5fba0109a6f455e30d405054a9d9e5ee25aa6: A photo collage consisting of six panels, exhibited as a whole. The image consists of colour and black-and-white photo fragments depicting various women's faces (among others Ly Unt, Ene-Liis Semper), face and body parts, details of a rubber doll, a breast mould, a barcode. In the lower right corner, the edge of the image (a woman's hip) extends beyond the picture frame. In the centre of the photo panel hangs a framed hologram image - a portrait of a fair-haired woman (Maria Avdjuško).
05f68814f2b09a8214de43a822046b74f13bf262: The square is full of peasants' ladder wagons, each harnessed to a single horse. Around them, peasant men, women in folk costume and townspeople making purchases are busy. In the background the main façade of the town hall, in front of which stands a striped sentry box. On the right a low shop building and, somewhat further back, the old weigh house with a high saddle roof, its second-floor wall surfaces between the windows adorned with medallions. In the background on the right the baroque spire of St. Nicholas' Church is visible.
7af45264d6c38d5e44b98d1a7d085edc9e7bfa34: Benjamin Vassermann (b. 1949 in Kirov Oblast, Russia) graduated from the Estonian State Art Institute in graphic art (1979) and has participated in exhibitions since 1978. Vassermann has been a member of the Estonian Artists' Association since 1989 and a member of the Estonian Association of Printmakers since 1992. He practises free graphic art in intaglio printing techniques (etching, aquatint) and digital printing. He has also created watercolours, posters, book designs and has designed catalogues and record covers.
28c97da12cec8110a2fdf10fbff5581f7f1385b6: Geboren im Gouvernement Orjol. Studierte Kriegswissenschaften an der Universität Dorpat und gleichzeitig das Zeichnen bei K. A. Senff. 1827 bewarb er sich um die Stelle des Zeichenlehrers an der Universität Åbo. Er schickte Probezeichnungen dorthin und wurde auch angenommen, trat jedoch die Stelle in Åbo nicht an. Lebte in Dorpat bis 1841. Von Zeit zu Zeit beschäftigte sich mit der Kunst, vor allem mit dem Porträt. Lebte nachmals in Moskau und Tbilisi.
a3afd08e1264036111d0e0e93582b483a37a3c48: Ilme Kuld (1938) is the author of numerous lyrical female figures. Her works have won great public favour. She has used wood, plastic as well as marble as materials. Over the last few decades she has participated in European sculpture symposia, and a considerable part of her figural sculptures have remained abroad, especially in France. Ilme Kuld is equally masterful in wood sculpture and in marble. Some of her works have also been cast in bronze.
c99291d13eb35248c27f734ad4f526fa3f47814a: Anna-Liisa Kree (b. 1981) is an Estonian photographic artist who focuses on the themes of domesticity and social representation, especially neglect and the inclusion of children with disabilities. She works in the medium of analogue photography, preferring to print and process her photos herself, making the whole process an inseparable part of her creative work. She studied at the University of West London, UK, in 2008-2011, Photography and Digital Imaging, BA, and at the Estonian Academy of Arts in Contemporary Art (MA 2024).
1f646b1c3039d11f398b825611923fa623359741: Tõnis Paberit graduated from the Estonian State Art Institute in sculpture. He has worked as a lecturer in the art department of the University of Tartu, in the Konrad Mägi painting studio, at the Tartu Art School, and is currently an associate professor at the Pallas University of Applied Sciences. His main directions in creative work are psychological portraiture, conceptual installation and monumental art, as well as retrospection. Over the last decade Paberit has been working with peat and soil in sculpture.
a2fa3ef6d22bc208bc6823f87b67c0fda45effc3: An installation consisting of male and female figures wearing swimwear and two cats. A small ball in the woman's hand moves with the help of an electric motor. On one cat the tail moves, on the other the tongue moves in and out of the mouth. The figures are adapted from plastic mannequins, repainted in white and pinkish tones, with white stickers resembling seed cells glued onto the man's trousers and onto the ball in the woman's hand. The figures wear glasses. The figures rest on round metal stands
9bdf652c587ba3e478dfb7323dd7b506e50c6825: A two-part shape on a blue surface begins at the upper left. A rounded red form has a crescent-shaped left edge that is white. An uneven red line curves into the middle of the painting, where a pinkish-white triangle-like image is located, slightly to the right of the central axis, from which grow two leg-like parts in blue tones; between them red paint emerges in trickling drips. The "legs" are bent at the knees, twisted out to either side.
75cb05e17bfd65344f4822236ddd6ad7956968da: In the upper right quarter of the painting, in an open doorway, a blonde young woman in a light blue loose summer dress with a basket, painted in a flat, sketch-like, thinly painted manner, the figure appears more like a silhouette. Below, a fragment of a white table on which stands a bright blue vase with colourful meadow flowers and a lilac-pink bowl. On the left, part of a room painted in a reddish-brown background with a chest of drawers and a mirror in a wide frame, against a green background with clearly distinguishable brushstrokes. The floor of the room is in ochre tones.
cf8f22c4cffb71d4e140bda8bda7ebf554ff35b9: A scene from the Tallinn market. In the foreground, old women selling flowers. Bareheaded, with combed-back hair, wearing sunglasses, an apron with a bib over a colourful dress, one flower seller sits with her hands in her lap. Beside her on the ground are vessels with cut flowers. To her right stands another woman, with glasses, short hair, a kerchief around her head, holding flowers which she offers. Passing them from right to left is a stout woman in a striped dress, carrying a basket of eggs. Behind, the Estonia theatre.
a2b78a2448b91a58819cbe2cfd3aa17906130ffd: Already in childhood Kaljo Simson showed skill in drawing and exhibited at school exhibitions both in Estonia and Sweden. During his arrest in 1949, according to the artist, 500 drawings, watercolours and oil paintings were destroyed. In the camp he worked as an artist, fulfilling commissioned works. From that time, postcard designs, sketches and portrait drawings have survived. It was then that the artist developed a deeper interest in depicting the human face and nature, which continued later throughout his entire creative period.
d06e13e1a7a4be911d3713289b0760ec4932cae4: Ann Pajuväli (1990) works mainly with drawing and installation, capturing quiet moments that in their ordinariness remain unnoticed. Moving between the familiar and the abstract, she reduces objects to poetic fragments, playing at the edge of recognisability. Pajuväli's work is guided by intuition rather than a fixed narrative, creating works with a dreamlike quality. She creates a world where time seems to stretch — a meditative space that is at once personal and universal.
96bbc6f1942be0f91fc04971d3357718ceb13c33: Geometrically simplified bust figures of two women. In front, on the left, a woman with green hair, close to the head, falling into a braid at the back, in half-profile to the right, in a light green robe with a triangular cutout; behind her, in the centre of the picture field, a woman with yellow hair, with a lowered gaze, tilting her head to the right (in relation to the viewer), in a greyish-blue dress with a deep décolletage. Near her shoulder, an orange-red sphere. The background consists of coloured geometric shapes.
b53ca0b7d314767505bb8383d0912749f88f7f14: At the top centre, the text "All Things Electric". Two motifs depicting artificial landscapes alternate with two blocks of English text. In the upper image, a man in a black suit, holding a suitcase and a cane. In the sky, a planet-like object. A white winding line connects the man's chest to the object. At the bottom left, a depiction of a dragon. In the lower image, an artificial landscape from which two cone-shaped and one cylindrical formation rise. They are surrounded by a grove of trees. At the bottom right, a walking human figure.
bf63bd1c76c0282e6c1970a36bef2425a4ed00ba: Karin Strohm is an Estonian artist who lives and works in Munich. She holds a master's degree in painting from the Estonian Academy of Arts and has worked as an artist-painter at the Estonian National Opera. Strohm's work explores desire as a manifestation of biological and aesthetic force. Recurring motifs — minks, insects and diamonds — embody both attraction and danger at once. In her dreamlike, often too-beautiful landscapes, beauty, instinct and a delicate shade of anxiety intertwine.
2f1a88d3012a3a5652b3f3eedd917f204f3107d6: Kristi Tüvi (b. 1994, Tallinn) is an Estonian artist and photographer whose work is characterised by a combination of pure aesthetics, timeless minimalism and high-quality visuals. Her works move along a delicate boundary between commercial photography and contemporary art, creating a visual whole that transcends both fields. Tüvi is by education a psychologist and philologist, but she has shaped her artistic identity primarily through independent practice and continuous self-development.
1751c7ca370e269dfb1f5360e2468160dc45399b: A panoramic mountain landscape: in the distance, a harsh-looking mountain range, in the middle a lake or fjord bordered on both sides by mountains with steep slopes. In the foreground, a wavy, pebbly mountain slope, in the lower right corner the head and chest of two men wearing hats, the man on the left with a long stick on his shoulder. At the top edge, a strip of clouds cut through by the peaks of the mountains situated on either side of the fjord. Between the mountain peaks above, a greyish-blue sky. Painted mainly in pink, ochre and bluish-green tones.
1e696591fd7ccf1edb917b586870245221686fc3: A large composition with flower stalls receding from the foreground into the depth, shaded above by colourful parasols. Between the flower stalls, people rendered in a large decorative generalisation. On the stalls, bouquets of flowers, clumps of gladioli, in the background new buildings and a crane. The sky is light blue, bright sunlight casting sharp shadows on everything. Among the figures in the foreground, a girl and a woman, and on the right a woman with a white bag and a man. Painted as colourful, decorative colour surfaces.
9221db48a160372fc853d76cdfd3dbc405d3fe69: A street scene rendered with a thin layer of colour, in a watercolour-like manner, marking the main details. In the centre, a street receding into the depth of the picture, with a green car and a brown house resembling a shed on the left. On the right, a light-coloured three-storey house with a reddish-brown roof, whose windows and doors are marked with coloured lines. In front of the house, a green motor car. On the horizon, electricity and telephone poles, greenery of trees. The sky is light grey, with isolated light blue patches. The cardboard is largely left uncovered with paint.
b3ede1bf814af17ac243181330c09bdf9810d6ee: Under a smoky starry sky at the edge of a forest with conical spruces, in the middle of a clearing around a blazing bonfire, people sit on benches and on the ground, holding beer mugs. The glow of the fire falls on the figures and casts shadows toward the viewer. On the left, further back, a crowd of people dancing to the accompaniment of an accordion. On the right, under the trees, a truck with a green box, PX-8-02, and smaller vehicles. A clearly outlined manner of depiction with stylised forms. Predominantly moss-green, olive tones, a bright blue arc of sky.
9fe335a0beae08be3ce51230990edb29b4fc66cf: In the foreground, a birch trunk, on the left a woven cradle hangs from a branch. In it, a child in a white shirt, having risen to a sitting position, turned a quarter to the right, looks and smiles at a mottled bird sitting on the branch. Further back in the clearing, a young woman raking hay, bent halfway over, her gaze turned toward the bird. The woman wears a white blouse and a headscarf, a longitudinally striped skirt. In the distance, under a light sky with isolated clouds, curly trees border the clearing. The painting is in a pastel greenish colouring, the paint layer thin.
53117bbb1e0155a9af91ae5356c50fe571486ccb: A general festive day of the people (genre painting), 1971. A stylised multi-figure composition of a song and dance festival, in the foreground of which is a magnificent brass band, somewhat behind them folk dance groups, and quite far away, singers under the song festival arch. Over the open ground a view opens onto Tallinn Bay, where magnificent full-sailed ships are sailing, and onto the city of Tallinn lined with tower spires. 99252915611cac2177ac996700aea3128ec134e1: In the foreground, strongly enlarged details from Heda's still life: on the right a half-filled goblet, a dagger, a half-eaten pie with spilled filling, a piece of pie on a metal plate, and on the left a fallen glass broken at the edge. Behind the pie, an ordinary, half-filled glass, the whole still life on a white cloth with rolled-up edges. Behind the table, a boy in a blue blouse and a green jacket with breast pockets, one eye closed, the other open. Background dark green.
342317cde35e404e15037b686d1214259af679f5: In the middle, a male figure stands in the river water, a white cloth around his hips, his body turned to the left. On the left, another man stands bent over - John the Baptist, touching with his right hand the head of Christ standing in the water. John's clothing is in green-red tones. On the right side of the river stand three bowing angels, facing toward Christ. In the lower left corner stands a small tree, in whose crown a black axe is placed horizontally. At the top centre, the symbol of the Holy Spirit - a white dove.
52d4099fab89b9d0aaeba286e1082817f1bd825d: View of the Kadriorg bathing salon from the sea side. In the middle of the round lawn, a tall flagmast secured with ropes all around. At the top flies a long pennant with a pointed end bearing text, on the left side the flag of the Russian state. The round lawn area is bordered by a footpath, where there are many strollers: ladies, gentlemen, children and dogs. People are also sitting on the benches bordering the footpath. On the open terrace facing the garden of the long salon building, there are many people. In the back on the right, a pavilion where an orchestra is playing.
31a60d9ca7723dc0dd0c4869b90dbd33388151bb: View of the Keila waterfall and the buildings of Keila manor in the 19th century. In the foreground, the western bank of the Keila river with isolated trees. On the left in front, two gentlemen. In the middle, the river water falls as a waterfall from the limestone bank, isolated rock boulders visible. On the left, on the eastern bank, a water mill with two support posts. On the eastern bank, among the trees, a stone dwelling, whose yard is bordered by a stone wall with a gate arch. On the right in the back, single-storey servants' dwellings with small windows. Above the waterfall, in shallow water, a boy with two horses.
51920d1aa722426c4b2fa84daf77f00b8cd31897: Composition painted mainly in grey tones: in the foreground on the right, a young woman's nude figure sits on a chair in pale light. On the lower left, a table with bottles, paint tubes and an ashtray. Behind the table, in profile, a male figure in black-and-white striped attire (A. Hoidre?). The background is an interior formed of abstract colour patches. Above the vertical centre line, a figure resembling a small devil, purple at the top and pink at the bottom. Two perforation holes on the right edge.
d78d1e45260cf057064a7ef0bcaf17dd0f30dd3a: Kairo is a self-taught artist who considers 2009 to be the beginning of his artistic career. Alongside painting on canvas, he has also been active on the streets, signing his early stencil works under the pseudonym Sorro at the time. As an artist he readily uses the term naivist to describe himself, in order to characterize the colourfulness and richness of detail of his work, and a certain indifference towards realistic depiction of anatomy, space and the like. Member of the Tartu Artists' Union since 2018.
2b9a71235e8efc9c7c312951455443393de87f75: A composition of clearly outlined, decorative, geometric shapes. In the lower part, a cross-section of a bus is depicted, with the driver and three passengers shown as silhouettes, portrait figures, in profile facing left. In the middle, two vertical columns built up of two regular rectangles each. On the right, repetitions of the elements on the left.
bff872cdd6e17f2f7d63e06fa4fc8da6632f106f: In the foreground, a pole fence with a man carrying an oar over his shoulder above a gap in it. On the left, a river running diagonally to the middle edge of the picture, which in the middle area joins a larger, lake-like body of water. On the higher far bank of the river, deciduous trees and a stone building with a tower. To the right of it, on lower ground, a Gothic-style church. On the right, along the lake shore, a row of farm buildings among trees. In the distance, the silhouette of another church tower is visible. On the surface of the lake, a rowing boat with three passengers, and sailing boats further away. A full moon in the night sky.
133fb23f48229197a48f03718deee402283ecbfe: A geometrically stylized composition with a frontal-view female figure in the centre foreground. The woman has short-cropped thick hair, black stockings and underwear, and red high-heeled shoes. In front of her, an oval mirror, a table covered with toiletries. Part of the figure is reflected in the mirror. Lower right, the shadow-like silhouette of a man with a hat and a cane. The background is a composition of geometric shapes. Black, glowing red and blue tones predominate.
35a7dc25e9897f82df559d9380441faee633dabc: In the centre of the painting, a male figure (Lauristin) stands at a lectern, holding a white sheet of paper in his left hand. To his right and left, the chairmen of the Politburo, headed by Stalin. In front of the tribune, members of the ESSR delegation stand facing forward. Red flags above the beginning and end of the row. To the right of the lectern, a white flag with red edges and images. On the flag, the number 19 10 05. Behind the crowd in the hall, a door on the right, and to the right of it a projector. On the wall behind the tribune, a statue of Lenin.
11c2a0cf414078e2c4b2475ddb34513d85425c34: Five female nudes: in the centre, a frontal-view woman with her arms raised above her head, right leg forward and slightly raised, bent at the knee; around her, upper left, a woman in profile facing left standing on her left leg; lower left, a three-quarter figure in semi-profile facing right; upper right, a figure in profile facing left with arms raised, standing on the right leg, left leg bent at the knee over the right; lower right, a three-quarter figure in profile facing left, bending backward, right arm stretched straight upward.
8f6154f5a86a5b078573fcfb2e207ff521abb346: In brownish-grey tones, lower left of the painting, a bust portrait of a dark-haired man in profile facing right. Lower right, a similar profile portrait of a woman with long dark hair looking back at him. The woman wears reddish-pink clothing, the man a white collar and a dark suit. Upper centre, a dark square resembling a window opening, in which is placed a reddish-brown round vase with a small white flower. 4cf9b5388344fad220e12202523de9b8563f6a51: A thematic composition in gloomy blue and purple tones. In the foreground, four fishermen in winter caps mend a net. Behind them on the left stands a woman in a headscarf, holding a fish crate in each hand. Behind the woman, the mast and rigging of a fishing boat are visible. Lower right, a pile of wooden fish crates; upper right, part of a net shed, in whose doorway a man stands sideways to the viewer. In the distance, a dark blue sea and sky, separated from each other by a bright red streak of the rising sun.
73fb8ca4fb7b856004e8a3563d12ace6f5e9ba75: A three-quarter figure of the artist, frontal view: hair receded from the forehead, a sharp gaze through spectacle lenses, brow furrowed. On the left edge, a nude figure in profile, cut off by the edge of the picture. The background is blue, darkening in the upper corners. 1116c7abacdad12e79aba59832c723c3f045a686: In the foreground, a group of men in dark clothes and caps, some carrying bags, push forward from left to right. Slightly left of the vertical centre line, a man on a brown horse, turned toward the viewer with his face and body. The men's faces are rendered without individualization, as patches. In the background, trees strongly bent by the wind, above them a dark, greyish-blue sky with a single white cloud on the left. The colouring is dark, with the thin paint layer letting the canvas show through in places.
d06e12b937a82fc803cd026aef34291179a979b0: Mari Kartau aka Siram (b. 1968) has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in art history, studied at the non-formal art education institution Academia Non Grata, and also holds a forestry education. In her work she has mainly engaged in performance and painting, and to a lesser extent has also made installations and graphic art. She has curated numerous exhibitions and written art criticism. She was more active in the field of art in 1992–2015, but is still active today.
87f8b2c6f683c41a6b9889702e3cab0ed4b35a35: Johanna Mudist is an Estonian painter who currently lives and works in Tallinn. She obtained her bachelor's degree at the Tartu Art College (2010–2014) and her master's degree at the Estonian Academy of Arts (2014–2017). She has also studied under the Erasmus programme in Finland (2013) and Poland (2015–2016). She has participated in numerous group exhibitions both in Estonia and abroad (Finland, Poland, Lithuania, the Czech Republic). She has been a member of the Estonian Painters' Union since 2016.
00b1047793ae27b1c4724195257120f49d310257: A figural composition in brown tones, consisting of a host of men moving from left to right, accompanied by a spotted leopard walking with them at the lower left. The leopard's left front paw is raised. The men wear brown trousers and coats; the man walking foremost has a checked coat. All the walkers' gazes are directed diagonally upward. On a higher hill on the right is a balustraded balcony, from which a company observes the landscape. In the distance, on the Pirita river, a sailing boat and a rowing boat. Across the river, a steep sandstone bank is visible. The convent ruins are surrounded by the low wall of a cemetery.
6e85500d6c9758189edecc9ba385e73f6eecd0b9: An abstract composition in bright colours: at the bottom centre, a green surface that seems to recede into depth, narrowing toward the horizon, with yellowish-green stripes converging in the same direction on both sides. 21546055ec55d1a826371028d50721726e135b0b: He exhibited at exhibitions in Saint Petersburg and Moscow at the exhibitions of the artists' association "Novoe Obšestvo" and in the salons Mir Isskustva and Obšestvo Nezavissimõh. 2e73e72da8b602bba47eab379d148250eb37b113: Jüri Mildeberg is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association, the Estonian Association of Graphic Designers, and the Estonian branch of IBBY. He has illustrated children's books, collaborated with magazines, and created the identity of Estonian Public Broadcasting in 2005. In addition, he painted the window shutters of the hall of the Estonian Children's Literature Centre (2008) and created ex libris. His works belong to the art collection of the National Library of Estonia and to the illustration collection of the Estonian Children's Literature Centre.
f5d0ffbcfbbf11be8dbbd08c3fe917e78afe8e16: Mirjam Varik (b. 1990, Tallinn) has graduated from the Tartu Art College in photography and from the Estonian Academy of Arts in graphic design. She is currently studying in the master's programme in contemporary art at the Estonian Academy of Arts. Varik explores in a narrative manner memories, places and phenomena connected with small joys, fears and worries. Through photography, video and installation she observes the seemingly insignificant things that continually influence a person's development.
b52318885fa1d42ae78fbf0bf7145720ae9f59ee: Laura Berta Vahtra (b. 1993) is a painter who lives and works in Tallinn. She graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts, Department of Fine Arts, majoring in painting, with a BA (2017). She has also furthered her studies abroad at the Haute École des arts du Rhin in France (2016-2017). She has participated in several joint exhibitions in Estonia and also in Germany. Laura Berta's work is based on self-reflection and is connected to perceptual themes of the body, memory and environment.
e35b1898272fb6dd99c413bf4c2bf2bdcef52bd5: Sven Grünberg is a pioneer of electronic music in Estonia. He has worked mainly as a studio musician, mostly performing his own works himself – handling all the instruments, singing, being the sound director and producer. He began his musical activity in the early 1970s as a keyboard player and singer in the bands Mikronid and Ornament, after which he led the progressive rock band Mess (1974–1976), which was the first of its kind both in Estonia and in the USSR.
44a397ab3111098eac6db13a39d384ce0e23f4ef: A three-dimensional composition of a river view with boats in the evening glow with the sun's reflection in the water. On the greenish water 9 rowing boats, in front on the right a motorboat with three passengers (two standing young men, a sitting young woman). 1/3 of the lower part of the painting depicts the water surface–bottom as three-dimensional. In the middle a perforated plastic sheet, on both sides overpainted folds of draped textile and canvas.
01044edcd565eb125b2dd82ca77ef480dfb1743d: In the lower part on the left a grayish-brown farmhouse with a low-hanging roof, surrounded by trees and bushes covered with faded-toned leaves. On the right a multi-branched tree with thin trunks, having lost almost all its leaves, tousled by the wind. Painted in gray and brown tones, in the lower part the leaves and greenery of the trees on the ground are rendered as pastose lumps of paint.
2ffa723107eb316f9a0550a9d180d0b799bef86b: In the foreground in the centre, spanning the entire vertical central axis, a pine tree, to the left of which, with her back to the viewer, a girl with long dark braids, wearing a white dress with a patterned lower hem and sleeves and a belt, her right hand raised to her eyes, looking at the sea. fc069e7f3c796e3417b6bddfb03d51373d6b0f60: Viive Kuks began her art studies in 1966 at the Tallinn Light Industry Technical School in the field of artistic textile design, which she completed in 1970. That same year Kuks began studies at the Tallinn Art University (EKA) in the field of graphic art. Her main teacher was Evald Okas. In 1976 she received a diploma in printmaking and moved to live in Võru, working as a freelance artist. Viive Kuks has been a member of the Estonian Artists' Association since 1984, and has participated in exhibitions since 1977.
14abf45366a2b638445e74acc51286b50df69d66: Priit Piirmets was born on 15.03.1948 in Hageri Parish. He came to Rakvere in 1956. He studied at Rakvere 1st 8-year school. He completed the Correspondence Secondary School in Rakvere. At Rakvere 1st 8-year school drawing was taught by teacher Gustavson. During secondary school he attended the art circle of the House of Culture, led by Ella Rajani. From 1973 he was himself the leader of an art circle. He was a member of the Artists' Union Youth Association. He considers Luulik Kokamägi his teacher and role model. In 1974 he moved to live in Tallinn.;
c357d48f7869a2288601613457e005501e82f675: In the foreground, a portrait of a young woman sitting on a brown chair, slightly turned to the right. Wearing a dress combined of black and gray fabric with a white collar. Her shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair is combed back from her forehead. The woman's right hand rests with the elbow on a table, on which there is a long row of books. In her hand a cup with a saucer made of greenish-gray clay. The background is covered with dotted black, through which a green tone shows below. Somewhat pastose, with clearly distinguishable brushstrokes.
8a2910ce4c24b371c06301096484c415f0676fdb: In the upper half of the sheet a blue semicircle divided into three parts by vertical lines, with an arc at the top. In the middle section symmetrically a turtle, msk, cane, gloves, key, tie, glasses, heart.
dc31f356e834ffaf90a734376fc3171c410b2a13: Upper left, white text: Academy Award Prizewinners. dc0d59c3ba53ad71e09074aec7d73e31dfd211e1: A view of Tallinn from the side of Nunna Gate. 005119ed60a86badc443608a280796f811a1acf0: Priit Kõiv (born 1956) is an Estonian artist and master of the wood and model-making workshop, who works at the Estonian Academy of Arts. He has participated in several exhibitions, including the joint exhibition "Garden of Eden. Reflections" with Külli Kõiv at the Jõhvi Town Gallery. He has also presented the photo exhibition "Invisible Moments" together with Pirjo Pesonen at the Kastellan House Gallery of the Vilde Museum. His work encompasses various techniques, including photo processing and digital print.
94bbee39bf6b30078ef6e6c282f36ffad2e33677: In the upper part of the picture, against a blue sky background, diagonally intersecting bridge structures made of iron and concrete (gray, white, red). In the lower right corner a brown bridge arch. On the left a river, above which airy metal railings are attached to the gray concrete pillars of a railway bridge running above. In the distance, on a very low horizon, a city in light tones. In the middle, at the bend of the metal lattice painted red, splashes of yellow and red paint.
d8c648c42c9027b975a10272c8c490782710864e: In the foreground, a gray stone parapet with pedestals rising higher. c4b5939740c4d435427f3e166b5f8f16f0b08ac9: A figural composition, in the foreground on the left two old women in Kihnu costume are standing, and in front of them a blonde girl in a red-striped skirt is sitting, with a cat in her lap. b822aca9840eec1f66cf267494eea8cd2470f1cc: Eva Juliane Magdalena (Magda) Zoege von Manteuffel was born, according to other sources, in 1852 and died in 1938. The date of her death is not clear. On her mother's side, von Maydell. She studied painting in 1891/92 under Onorato Carlandi in Rome and in Carl von Winkler's studio in Tallinn. She took part in touring exhibitions in Estonia in 1927 and 1929/30, and also exhibited watercolours in Riga, Petersburg and Moscow. 36b2d5345b4113a19b16b4454cdd69a46242f7b0: An arrangement composed of objects of geometricized form: in the middle a yellowish-brown guitar with white and brown patches instead of strings. To the right of the guitar a poison-green box with a yellow interior, a brown pipe with its stem end inside it. In the sixties he also designed several books and postcards, mostly as commissioned work for the Estonian State Publishing House (1948–1962), and later for the publishing houses Eesti Raamat, Kunst and Perioodika. Sampu's design graphic work was created alongside his main job at the Tallinn Pedagogical Institute, where he worked as an art lecturer from 1960 to 1980.
869a496090b18e6ad4ffccf681d7caac0bf5c3ff: Consists of four equal side-by-side panels, unprimed canvas.
