In the farmyard on the right the gable end of the dwelling house with a half-hip roof and a red-framed window. Next to the dwelling house a barn. On the right, lengthwise, a farm outbuilding. In the centre a draw-well. On the left in front a fence of slanted poles. A sunny summer day.
e2c17d8ff87a6d36703a4ce655d3f04c77d9503d: In the foreground of the painting a river with naked women bathing in it. In total there are 14 women in the picture, of which 6 are in the water. Most of the women (7) sit or lie on white towels on the right bank of the river. On the left bank a woman in underwear is getting dressed. At the bottom left one of the women has a child in her arms. The upper background of the painting is green, with a sandy-coloured edge of the riverbank. On the right side a tree, in the distance bushes of various sizes. The sky is also visible, uniformly blue.
ae765e9c842f3d7a447539ffedbe8d604d5a5173: Põldroos studied painting at the Estonian State Art Institute (ERKI) from 1952 to 1958 and was admitted to the Estonian Artists' Union in 1959. He then taught at the Tallinn Pedagogical Institute (from 1961 to 1966) and later also at ERKI/EKA (1973–1985 and 1994–1995). From 1985 to 1989 and 1995 to 1998 he was chairman and president of the Estonian Artists' Union. Since 1998 he has been a freelance artist.
2abb4584da77e36efd7e01b787b937452e719461: Aime Kuulbusch-Mölder graduated from ERKI in sculpture and is an honorary member of the Estonian Artists' Union. She began exhibiting already in 1969 and has held 19 solo exhibitions in Tallinn, Tartu, Stockholm, Helsinki and elsewhere. She has also created a number of portrait monuments and sculptures for public space. Portraiture, figurative free-standing sculpture and abstract large-scale forms hold an important place in her work.
b20516b84dcdfdba5203a4a3c28e6cd7a1b2cfd6: In the interior, in the right foreground, a woman wearing a hat sits on a round stool in profile facing left, her left leg over her right knee, her right hand in her lap, her left hand resting on the seat behind her. Behind the table on the left, the portrait silhouette of a person sitting with head bent forward to the right
48e884b50e1f307ffffab256212f991b2fc40484: In the foreground lies a peasant fallen in war, arms spread. A stout cudgel has slipped from between his splayed fingers. d0836f0591051e825acf4943560c51c1e4f969c4: In the foreground, beside a round table, sits a gentleman in a blue coat with grey hair and riding boots, embracing a barefoot boy in brown clothing who has come up to him. In front on the right lies a dog, and behind, two saddled riding horses.
1bae595204d822d2c67574d70ab3d1e379b83c4d: He studied at the Tallinn Peetri Secondary School, in 1925-1928 (with interruptions) at the Faculty of Physics and Mathematics of the University of Tartu, and in 1928-1936 at the "Pallas" art school in Tartu. In 1946-1951 he was a lecturer at the Tallinn State Institute of Applied Art, and in 1947-1950 chairman of the Artists' Union of the ESSR. In 1952-1967 he worked in Viljandi in various positions (director of a children's home, etc.)
2909ad89f3290a919ce8a4dcfb7e5c86fbd11630: In the foreground, within an area bounded by ropes, on a yellowish carpet, a male figure with his back turned is pulling off a blue shirt. On the left, a man bent over a chair, wearing a red shirt and cap, is beating a drum. A photograph of a strongman leans against the chair. On the ground lie a weight and lifting bars and a large green suitcase. In the distance a boy is collecting money from spectators gathered behind the rope. Further back circus wagons and tents with town houses visible in the distance.
6e5e23dad4465122ccf9fcfed4a0750ae4a1f8e7: In the foreground a river bend turning into the depth of the picture, to the right of which a small island or spit of land with bushes and two deciduous trees. The left, sandy bank of the river rises into a hill covered with pines. In the foreground on the left, an alder growing almost right out of the waterline, its reflection visible in the water. Further back in the centre, among the pines, a house with a white gable roof. Above, a blue, slightly cloudy sky. Painted with small, lush brushstrokes.
9436463e8cfcfe469ffc98a44ac184a56f2fdb38: A sea shore painted in grey and brown tones: in the foreground grass tufts, a boat drawn up onto the shore and fastened to a stake (a woman in a white bonnet lying sideways in the boat) and fish traps drying on posts. In the foreground centre a woman in a brown skirt, black jacket, white bonnet and apron, a fish basket under her arm. In the background a calm sea reaching to the horizon with a few boats, and a blue sky brightly lit from above with clouds.
0f79163e57168e73c8361bf1b33d878bd2de09c7: Martti Ruus (b. 1968) studied architecture and interior architecture at the Estonian Academy of Arts in Tallinn. He began painting in 2011 in Konrad Mägi's studio in Tartu. Ruus observes and stylises nature through an architectural and coloristic prism. Minimalist motifs, colour surfaces distinguishing themselves from one another, and the search for hidden connections are keywords of his work. He has participated in exhibitions, mainly in Tartu, since 2013.
bfd51c1009d90278ce9ba98f9d826ea355a187d5: Keithy Kuuspu (born 24 November 1994 in Tallinn) is an Estonian performance and dance artist, director and choreographer. Since 2021 she has been studying for a master's degree in ceramics at the Estonian Academy of Arts.
494ee8516f8e1f40c064dac45a228e5f4d77c77e: Against the background of a sea with rocky cliffs and a coastal village with small red houses, half-figures of a young woman and an old man in side view facing left. On the left, a young woman in a white headscarf and light-coloured clothing, hands clasped over her stomach. Behind her on the right, an old man with a hooked nose and moustache, wearing a cap, a light shirt and a black waistcoat. A drawing-like manner emphasising black contours. The paint surface appears rubbed thin, translucent in layers.
78f7bf7fbdaec9ce0822a6eeec9096cd1eba3b81: In the foreground centre, a person in oriental dress kneels weaving a carpet. Behind her, under a tent, on the left sheep, slightly to the right a standing woman with water jugs and a sitting boy. Between the women, further back, a pot hangs over a fire; behind the fire the heads of two women are visible. On the right, under the tent on a carpet, three men in oriental dress, two sitting with pipes in hand, the third standing pouring a drink into a goblet. Behind the men two horses.
b36a0e81c7408b133da814a4b79ac87182d36d5e: In the foreground centre, a street runs with houses on both sides: on the right a grey house with densely placed small windows and an arcade underneath, on the left a red house with sparse small windows. ee1f2095b61cfda2ff1dc21e70b846c84360d8a9: physician, studied in Berlin at Albert Reimann's art school in 1922, graduate of the University of Tartu (medicine 1923-1929), courses (sculpture) at the "Pallas" art school, private physician in Tallinn in the 1930s, evacuated to Tatarstan in 1941, physician in the Red Army from 1943, resident of the therapy department of Tallinn 2nd United Hospital from 1945, head, deputy chief physician for polyclinic matters, physician of the "Estonia" theatre, lecturer at the art institute in Tallinn
84bb09de998c429af7a051e186584c8e2b9d39fb: Rauno Thomas Moss (b. 1977 in Tallinn) is an Estonian painter and graphic designer who achieved widespread renown for his black-and-white colouring and autoerotic paintings. Carried by an interest in 19th-century medicine, Moss delves deeply into the touchpoints of his childhood memories and experiences, doing so in a vivid and slightly dreamlike surrealist estrangement. The result is disturbing and memorable.

Solo exhibitions in Dresden, Berlin and Riga.

dbc5d40cfe40d43e0285026e044122a2af8fc519: Erika Tammpere (b. 1942 in Rakvere) is a textile artist with long experience, whose work combines a deep sense of material, social sensitivity and a contemporary form. 7aa30191114908b0d842bc28700a3d2353abb05b: Contains plans of farms and collective farm buildings (pigsty, henhouse), drawings of various machines (a groats-grinding machine, a machine for obtaining fine flour, a boiled potato crusher, a wind turbine turning mechanism, an automatic machine for cutting tabletops for fuel, etc.) and pieces of furniture (rocking chair, cupboard, table, stove), drawings of tools - in total on 46 sheets, of various sizes. 15e1c120b04aa6da24fb6d88b7268e31e13012e1: Sven Senka is an Estonian artist who works mainly in the media of painting, sculpture and graphic art. His work moves in the borderlands between expressive and geometric abstraction, addressing philosophical, historical and existential themes. Senka's artistic practice is characterised by a subjective and idealistic approach, in which image, structure and colour function as means of interpretation.
d4107e8255dba24e79575f02b30d86df2c02dd3a: Robert Suvi (born 8 June 1947 in Tartu) is an Estonian artist and educator, known primarily for his practice of monumental painting. He received his initial art education at the Tartu Art School from 1962 to 1967, studying in the speciality of artist-teacher. Later he continued his studies at the Estonian State Art Institute (ERKI), where he studied painting from 1971 to 1976, specialising in monumental painting.
4c49760275404464b7af94640c7152ff8b0d4919: A river landscape seen from above. In the distance in the middle, rising terrain.
8ca5ac81d85c87c35f68a57b236bc80515713faa: Bust portrait of a young man painted after a photograph: the man's head and gaze turned to the right, straight nose, clear direct-looking eyes, hairline receded on both sides at the temples. addba2652d0fd14062a531a55a147b8c7ddad383: Slightly to the right of the vertical axis of the composition, a frontal portrait of an old woman with a wrinkled face modelled with grey and brown straight lines, in a slight turn to the left, head tilted slightly to the right. c9e41490422bd3721e71e562588c5f7ee6629775: In the upper right part of the picture a greenish factory building with a large window made up of small squares. 61cf427cf6140988b2152dc7bf233837bcabcc09: He studied at Arumetsa Primary School and at the Tartu Boys' Science Gymnasium, graduating from gymnasium in Viljandi. In 1934 he studied at the Pallas Higher Art School in Ado Vabbe's graphic art studio. In 1940-1941 he studied at the Konrad Mägi State Higher Art School. ea77e9757cb731f06455f2999b640cf6fcc46d19: In 1980 he graduated from the Tartu Art School. In 1991 he graduated from the Tallinn Art University as a painter. Lecturer at the Tallinn Art School. In 1987 he took part in a youth exhibition, in 1989 in a national exhibition. In 1992 became a member of the Artists' Union. Solo exhibitions: 1989 at G-Gallery, 1991 at Galerie Viro, Helsinki; 1992 Tokko&Arrak; 1993 in Espoo; 1994 KH Gallery; 1997 Sammas Gallery; 1998 "Estonia" theatre; 2002 Narva Hermann Castle; 2004 Vaal Gallery.
34a62ebe2a836d824fd241676262d13058c215f0: In the centre a group of people taking Christ down from the cross, at the moment of Christ's release from the cross. 23fcaf812200ad40193f9e00228d3bbdeb59ebd6: A portrait painting, in a naïve style, depicting a man in a suit and tie - frontal view. 10438bb6c4866094a15e8fb33107f58ed9440e12: Kaljuvee worked as the director of the Rakvere MEK from 1980–1986, as chairman of the Rakvere district Executive Committee from 1987–1990, as governor of Lääne-Viru county from 1990–1992, as a board member of Kunda Nordic Tsement from 1992–1994 and as chairman of the supervisory board from 1994–1999, as director of the Eastern region and deputy director general of Eesti Hoiupank from 1994–1998, and as a board member of Eesti Põlevkivi from 1999–2006 and as chairman of the board from 2006–2007.
03a65a5ee9f99b8c21df3dea21c3d39fb60fd4ff: In front of an open door, on the outdoor stairs, a young lady in light-coloured clothing and a wide grey hat kneels. ef045732a84655c5051a49df2ae46f99fa81679d: Ove Maidla was born in Tartu on a cold winter evening in 1959 at a quarter to nine. Maidla is a Tartu photographic artist of a lyrical temperament. He likes to work on the borderline between photography and printmaking, and is especially interested in old noble techniques, which produce a painterly image as a result. Maidla has mainly remained devoted to the bromoil technique and photogravure. His newest passion at the moment is linocut.

fbce3e61e5fdaf33fd1db512a51dfe835fe2c36e: August Pulst was involved in the founding and management of the Estonian Museum of Art, the Estonian Theatre and Music Museum, the Tori Museum, and the Estonian Open Air Museum. Pulst, Ants Laikmaa, Kristjan Raud, Mihkel Aitsam, and Peeter Parikas founded the Tallinn branch of the Estonian National Museum, which in 1919 was converted into the Tallinn Estonian Museum, from which the present-day SA Eesti Kunstimuuseum [Art Museum of Estonia Foundation] has grown
4d87fab1f359ce16c39e699fb9e00e5901f56794: Against a background of dark brown drapery, on a dark table, a glass vessel with small purplish chrysanthemum flowers; beside the flowers, on the left, a tall-footed copper ecclesiastical vessel with a lid topped by a small cross. To the right of the flowers are two thicker books placed one on top of the other, and in front of the composition, on a white cloth, a third, smaller book with three apples.
61d6d30fad11c18546119bcaece6d08182904c35: A stylised, three-quarter-length figure of a young woman shown seated, facing frontally. 5e7033a3b68ea4565500c4296dba7a622d724285: In the foreground three male figures: the man on the left, grey-haired and dressed in grey, holds a measuring rod, the man in the middle, wearing blue trousers, has a bag over his shoulder, the man on the right wears a peaked cap and grey trousers. d17d9d8bd03c1c69b46eb63fdc918c66603310a7: In the foreground, on the left and right, a group of women in greenish and brown coats, with sharply pointed hats, muffs, and boas. 7d6d6d53298ba2ddf3a97c0c21790cf691e4df01: A half-length figure of a man seated, wearing a dull green coat with open lapels and a loosely hanging scarf, a blue shirt, and a brown hat on his head, in a slight turn to the right, his hands resting on his knees, a cigarette between the fingers of his left hand, his head slightly tilted to the left; a glassy gaze looking down in front of him. 5e7462a34ca3623cedfcde8788adee25bcea716f: Urmas Viik graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in 1991 in the field of graphic art. He has been a professor in the art department of Tallinn University and for a long time headed the graphic art department of the Estonian Academy of Arts. Viik has illustrated dozens of children's books, and the books he has designed and illustrated have repeatedly won awards in the competitions for the 25 Most Beautiful Estonian Books and the 5 Most Beautiful Estonian Children's Books.
7d5eb480970b82ea56de7c745aa5a40f28239c4c: Four half-naked women seated in a room (studio) decorated with antique objects. On the black-and-white part of the painting, an imitation of craquelure or crack lines has been painted on.
17b4e460e53c88e88906d65187b01f29a6bc418a: In a kitchen interior in greyish-brown tones, in the middle, facing frontally, a woman stands behind the stove. On the right, in front of the hearth fire, in profile facing right, seen from behind, a crouching, barefoot figure. In the interior, at the back in the centre a table, beside which on the right wall a large ladle. Painted in dark, brown-grey tones.
9842f8ff19b574b0df1648335799689a5c129e51: An installation consisting of two paintings, two side panels and a sun. Kaido Ole's painting "Kenotaaf" depicts a man lying in profile under a grass cover and a thick layer of soil. Placed on top of the painting is Andres Tolts's work "Maamõõtjad" (M 7579), and above that in turn is the sun. The composition is flanked on both sides by side panels, the left one depicting the letter "A", the right one "T".
a8b62a4652e8e24ad5be50a9db80db1d005109e5: The meeting of Koidula and Kreutzwald in Võru, seated on a garden bench beneath trees. Koidula on the left, her face turned towards her interlocutor, fluffy curly hair falling onto her shoulders. She wears a dark, wide dress with flounces, her hands with a shawl in her lap. The man sits turned towards the woman, left leg over right. Bare-headed, a coat on his shoulders. He looks seriously ahead of himself. His right forearm rests on the back of the bench.
8f7150605a0f04d725eee7ab6d521645789576fd: In the right foreground three soldiers in plumed helmets attack a bearded man in armour, whose beard one of the warriors has seized. A second soldier has clutched the man's hair and holds a short sword in his hand, a third stabs the bearded man with a spear. In front of the feet of the man under attack lies already one lifeless old man. In the distance soldiers march with flags and spears. On the left in front three soldiers with weapons.
e820094b0427f2bbd5a65ef0a142eb6647612f8a: Merit Paenurm (b. 1995) is a young artist who lives and works in Tallinn. She has studied painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts, and her main means of expression is painting. In addition to classical painting, the artist has also engaged in installation art. In her works Merit tries to express her own world of thought, her own vision of life, and to physically depict formless phenomena.
ca28204213f41e6c9562b2bfb4579a65f5bebdc9: Martin Rästa (b. 1980) is a graphic designer, interdisciplinary artist and musician, who in his works focuses on the synthesis and integration of sound and visual art, using various experimental forms and media for this purpose. His activity is based on cognitive processes and empirical perception, accompanied by an interest in existential questions and technology.
4dece6a7adecd746afb92557e9172e62057a2eda: A grey road running from the lower left corner of the picture field to the horizontal centre, with three figures in clear view at its end. In the background dense shrubbery with a few tall trees. In the right foreground a bush. In the middle ground on either side of the road on the grass two tall slender deciduous trees with branchless trunks. A light blue sky with light white clouds, becoming creamy towards the horizon. A bluish-green overall tone.
596f9e1d440c0dbd52970f6f45523c65f88e0517: A reddish-purple background, which becomes lighter towards the centre of the painting. In its centre an upside-down kidney-shaped matte black form surrounded by a projecting, jaggedly edged orange wreath, whose uneven edge curls over the black surface. The latter is covered with a luminescent, glowing paint, with rivulets flowing onto the background. In the lower part of the painting a blackish-grey cross-section of the ground, cell-shaped soil layers in uneven stripes.
82bdefcfb033174540125b353aefd4bbfbde79e7: A street curving from the foreground into the depth of the picture, lined on both sides by trees. On the street to the left a row of old-fashioned vehicles, on the right a large cart. In the middle of the street a cyclist and a person crossing the street. On the left edge of the street a raised barrier pole and a row of houses. The sky light blue. The paint layer very thin, in places leaving the underlying cardboard bare, the manner of painting sketch-like, the tones pastel.
26f9eaceb4d81d05ff3090afc17a2ee0f162ea97: A suburban landscape in grey and brown tones: in the foreground a street running parallel to the edge of the picture, on the left the street runs perpendicular to the one in the foreground towards the horizon. On the left and right low wooden houses and long dull fences. Here and there a few electricity poles, in the background two light-coloured tall houses. On the street a small male figure and another female figure are moving. Above the horizon a grey sky.
5a02d93497bbd914fdb953a9e5bc9cab39d30e80: On the left: a female nude standing frontally against a background that is golden-yellow below, marking sheaves of grain, and greyish ochre-toned with zigzag lines above, eyes closed, arms stretched out away from the body below. To her left a silvery scythe, to the right a depiction of a sickle. On the right of the painting, from a blackish background with zigzag lines, yellow dots and small red lines, a light female figure shines through in profile, head bowed.
f4bceddecc835b50455cf71fa0990530972bdc2d: A winter landscape, the ground covered with snow. Beside a horse stands a knight of the Order, wearing a coat with the image of a cross on the back. He holds in his hand a scroll, on which he is marking something. On the right stands an Estonian woman in snow up to mid-calf, one hand a fist, the other around a child, who holds onto her clothing. In front of them stands a starving dog with a drooping tail. Deep tracks in the snow lead to farm buildings in the background.
6e8601e7bc38656a903c11c213d350263f266702: Ivi Arrak paints with acrylic paints, her canvases filled with emotionally rich and harmoniously balanced compositions. Ivi Arrak's works stand out in today's Estonian art precisely for their good sense of colour and sensitive treatment of form. From seemingly abstract surfaces emerge highly generalised images, which guide the viewer into a wondrous world close to nature.
5f7f6ff3789a7297690f893058d20ba5e8906f0c: Through a glass door with white square-shaped handles, against the background of a landscape in bluish-green tones, a bluish-white tabletop. On the table a razor, an envelope, a book, a light bulb and a tube of paint. All painted in a transparent greenish-white gamut, in places with emphasized contours. Behind the glass door, on both edges in the upper quarter of the painting, shapes reminiscent of the corners of a balcony. The sky electric blue, with hazy clouds.
78b458f0962aa27c22be6b3a899fcb43554d039b: A vertically formatted, semi-abstract painting in light grey, brown and green tones, with a surface that is in places rough in texture due to the mixed technique used. Depicted is a storm-battered, split tree trunk resembling a tree stump, which seems to grow out of the lower part of the picture. Pictorially and stylistically the (stump-shape) is treated in a cubist, geometric manner. The background of the painting is divided into three parts: grey, brown, grey.
fe58fd573ccb7bd94cf547547941e807f5e14cc5: An interactive installation consists of 9 chairs, placed inside a plexiglass cube covered with a red carpet. 7 chairs are activated by a person's movement according to a predetermined scenario, 2 chairs are motionless (one upright, the other lying down). The chairs are fixed to a constructed floor and are protected from the viewer by plexiglass. One chair, when moving, also collides against the plexiglass wall.
78fe3efac1bc2bda3f8b8a3b677f879c11dc8c96: An assemblage entirely covered with paint, divided by a wavy horizontal line into red and black. Attached to the red part a painted wooden block, a wooden batten and two round metal technical parts. Attached to the black part a wooden batten, a wooden block, a plastic technical part, a spoon and a key, whose ring opening is painted white. The painted surface of the assemblage is glossy, evenly covered with craquelure.
ab0b166081555e75ba730845686fa4e8f1053259: Shop window mannequin (male mannequin), T-shirt, trousers, holding a net bag containing a roll of toilet paper and half a loaf of floor bread (bread to be added each time the work is exhibited), sneakers on the feet, artificial grass underfoot surrounded by a fence of clothes pegs, plastic artificial flowers on the grass; behind the figure a linoleum board with a background painting: light blue sky with small white clouds and text: Its so easy to be an artist
40b3970f92d445107fdc336c935890303a226969: Johann Andreas Krompein (1695 Reval - 1760 Narva). Son of the Swedish army lieutenant Christoph Friedrich Krompein. Around 1720 Johann Andreas moved to Narva and quickly made a career there in municipal offices. From 1722 he was town secretary of Narva, and from 1735 he was Narva's justice burgomaster and court bailiff. In 1723 he bought a house in Narva from Georg Bogislaus Stael von Holstein.
25b82e523d714b0282b90f209006fa2ff2eccdee: In the foreground a large lying cat, with kittens on its stomach and back and a mouse near its front paws. Behind the cat, placed in the crowns of small trees, a row of television boxes containing mice, with mousetraps in vertical position on top. The described motif as a whole repeats behind, smaller, diminishing in the perspective of the space. On the walls large mousetraps, an opening in the ceiling through which parachutists land
5f03b49dfabf02a024a48286131d7471c1ba7da5: In the foreground two stones of irregular shape, weathered at the top, both painted pastosely, with intersecting lines drawn on the stone surface. Under the left stone a pastose green stripe and above it a white no. 1. Under the right stone a red stripe and above it no. 2. Above the numbers, at the upper edge, a white horizontal stripe across the whole work. Background grey. Sand used across the entire surface of the picture to achieve relief.
f41fd0589a557b1a1f20aca913e212b608574d2a: Close-up view of a fragment of a crowd of people: some faces frontal, some in profile, at the lower edge one head seen from the back. Some women's faces apparently given as portraits: at lower left a woman with glasses, long light hair and a headscarf. At the centre of the composition a fair-haired woman with short hair and a straight nose, right hand raised to chest level. Blue and yellowish-green tones dominate.
63a3e1dfe96c6e8cfaf05e753172a19d0be3fb0f: The pale face of a young woman, turned half-way to the right, in a white headcovering-scarf with a lace edge, draped around the head, neck and shoulders. An oval yellow background surrounds the head. Wearing a purple-red robe, yellow in front, with black ornament, a tasseled seam at the neckline. On the surrounding parts, black ornament on a blue surface. In the lower left corner piece, part of a tree trunk, plant motifs.
d511092473cbcff4b69c6da07f7b5c1702076131: Studied 1888-1889 at the Uderna ministry school, then in Tartu at Pelberg's primary school and in 1891 at the town school. Received basic artistic knowledge 1899-1902 at the drawing courses of the Tartu German Craftsmen's Society. Continued art studies 1903-1905 as an auditor in St. Petersburg at Baron Alexander Stieglitz's School of Technical Drawing, focusing, as a student of Amandus Adamson, on wood carving and modelling.
8db25e4535622c94271e8f9bb67147cd1ae0ab72: Margus Kontus (1987) has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts' Contemporary Art curriculum (MA2020). Has participated in several group exhibitions and light festivals. Margus Kontus's work is characterised by the interpretation of magnetism through art. His works are like tiny meditations that seek connections between the visible and the invisible world. Since 2020 he has belonged to the art group DARKovSKY.
113a80718ef0c023087ef7265271ddc4d1cc1485: In the foreground, at lower left, the half-figure of a woman in profile to the right, a scarf on her head, right arm bent at the elbow at chest height. Behind, in a row, the half-figure of a standing man, slightly in front of him a woman in long attire seen frontally, head turned down to the left, on the right further back the figure of a woman standing frontally, in front of whom, slightly ahead, the figure of a man standing frontally, arms bent up to chest height
12355aa5cc900de140d5c33f480f11c5fb0be7b9: On a purple-pink base with a low horizon, on a background reddish at the bottom, turning through yellow to white and pink at the top, two abstract half-torsos with lobed heads, the one on the left in a darker, the one on the right in a lighter brown tone. Between them two vaguely shaped forms in lighter and darker red tones, in front of which lies an orange hand with a lemon-yellow cigar-like object between the fingers.
420fe92f2812ead326e3cbc897213f83ae9562e5: Born 05.02.1851, Tartu; died 03.03.1912. Education: Received basic knowledge in painting in Tartu from K. von Kügelgen and in lithography in C. A. Shulz's workshop. Continued studies 1872-77 at the Düsseldorf Academy of Art, including in 1874 with E. von Gebhardt and from 1875 with E. Dücker. Made study trips to Westphalia, the upper reaches of the Rhine and the North Sea islands. Studied briefly in Paris
6976f33f7ad8826d6562dabea5ac9188753c0235: Two full-length figures of girls in an interior. The one on the left, dark-haired, in a grey smock and red blouse, leans her back against a green stove. The other, seen frontally, fair-haired, in a dark skirt and lilac jacket, stands in front of the previous one, on the right side of the picture. On the right a corner of a table with a light blue cloth. In the upper right corner a red lampshade emitting yellow and red light.
e09b7a0d225fcbd3a0c1d2bea6843d24f19d308d: A square composition divided in half by a horizontal line. In the lower half diagonal surfaces: part of a quadrangle, as tall as the lower half, a narrow strip with three horizontal lines, a quadrangle with cross lines, a sharp angle. In the upper half horizontal and vertical lines dividing the surface into right angles. On the left and right, on either side of the centre line, two small black ovals each
b18edec0b262268530895b9e426cb277bda6ace7: In the foreground centre, in a room with light walls, a boy with straight hair, wearing brown trousers and a dark jacket, playing the violin. On the boy's hand holding the violin a bird with a long tail and greyish-brown plumage. In front of the boy a white triangular stool on which lies an open art album, behind the boy's back an opening into a restless, colourful world of objects. In the lower left corner paint pouring from an overturned paint can.
6c9ec1d4acb778877a5222b327e75ee1500aa4ae: On the right edge sits a blonde, curly-haired young woman on a dark chair, wearing a light blue short-sleeved blouse and a floral pinafore skirt, her hands folded in her lap, her gaze directed at the boy in front of her, who stands with his back to the viewer. The boy has light short hair, wears a blue blouse and brown trousers with braces. On the left the twilight of the room is marked in brown and grey.
93055f6dd408a657a3feee644953c49d40c45d23: Three-quarter figure of a young girl stepping forward, in a quarter-turn to the right. The woman's upper body slightly bent backward, turned towards the viewer. Left arm raised bent, right at her side. The girl wears a sleeveless light dress with a full skirt and a lush collar, and a cap with red and white flowers on her head. The colourful background and dress are painted pastosely, the face and hands more smoothly, following the roundness of the form.
de330a0160b4005c625b19240d57b78693fe2d6f: In the foreground the half-figure of a woman standing with hands on her hips. The woman has chestnut-coloured, medium-length hair, a fringe on the forehead, dark eyes and a strong, slightly hooked nose. A mouth with sharp contours in a slight smile. The woman wears a black fitted jumper with a large neckline and three-quarter sleeves, and a dark red skirt. Against a background predominantly in blue tones, a studio corner with shelves, pictures and a brush jar.
8eb71caa8eae478a803549485389cf1efd3e2480: In the foreground two groups of people: on the left a group of three people, on the right a number of people, a woman with baskets sitting at the very front. A path leads from the people into the depth of the picture, on both sides of the path dark green trees and bushes rendered roundly. In the background, against the sky between the trees, houses given with great geometric generalisation. Painted in deep colour tones, at places merging into one another.
79b89d09f1c7727d1e8f63c4fb6344ec8eddb2e2: In the foreground, with his back to the viewer, an Estonian with a spear in hand, a sword at his belt, an axe tucked into the belt, right hand extended outward. Facing him three more men: two armed, one with a bundle of pikes under his arm. In the centre, on a hillock, a log building blazes, from which the glow of fire spreads across the dark night sky and black clouds of smoke rise. Behind, on the left and right, bands of armed men and torch-bearers.
e0fbee9e5f81f4e99286689971319b23dfeda311: A three-part composition, predominantly in intense red and pink tones, with a coarse texture. On the left part a large woman's face outlined in pink, mouth, nose line, eye marked in black. On the right-centre, in the lower part of the painting, the half-figure of a lying man marked intermittently in black on a hazy red ground. A very relief-like painted surface, black contour lines in unevenly deep paint layers.
36defd007f3d3cd3cfa077d181e857ce90bbd27a: On a yellowish-beige base covered by a brown drapery, which forms the background across most of the width of the painting and whose edge falls loosely over the front edge of the base, slightly right of the central axis stand a tall, wide-necked glass jug, on the left a loaf of bread on paper, in front of it, in the left golden section, two large onions. On the right, on a small soup plate, a large glazed light greyish-blue mug.
286c0e06675622fc69d4d4c4cec37ec5759afeb7: View of a winter market square. In the foreground centre a black horse eating hay, with a hay cart. Further back a number of horses with carts, groups of people around them. In the distance in the centre a two-storey building, on the right one with a tower and smaller houses. The sky and ground merge into a uniform light grey-whitish surface, with occasional bluish and brown shadows on the snow. Painted smoothly, the ground somewhat more pastose.
f7b0caa772e930d9c468f49039cc2ee8e8e64aab: A middle-aged dark-haired woman sitting in an interior, in profile to the left, head turned over the left shoulder, gaze directed at the viewer. The figure cut off at ankle level. The woman wears a red-patterned smock dress with full sleeves and a red flounce. Her left bent arm at shoulder height rests on a yellowish-green carpet-like object in front of her. Painted pastosely with a vigorous, dense brushstroke.
80f0220f99fd621c8b55d5ca6c748286bea5a6b7: The sheet depicts a section of a baroque palace wall surface with numerous architectural details. Between two rectangular windows with small panes, a fresco with a military commander as the central figure. The man wears a helmet, holds a spear, and has a toga over his shoulders. On the left, in front of him, lictors march with bundles of rods and axes on their shoulders. To the right of the commander, soldiers with pikes. In the background, the buildings of an old fortress can be seen.
cbd7bddef8937789ba5fe1be8c6ad4b91222feeb: In the center of a uniform light yellow background, a purple-orange-black checkered rectangular surface is covered with spontaneous yellowish-orange arching brushstrokes. In the foreground, in the lower corners of the painting, symmetrical depictions of a brown tabletop, each with a turquoise-blue upward-widening, goblet-shaped vase with sharp-tipped, palm-like plants. Between the tabletops, a dark ledge from which a ribbon hangs.
dd6bd079a2b2593e4c4f919ec7e36cda73daf3d4: A hilly landscape in silvery-gray and dull green tones. In the center, a small hill covered with a patch of forest, surrounded by a landscape covered with low bush clusters. In the foreground, a path leads from the lower left corner into the depth of the picture on the right. On the right edge, a solitary spruce. Above the horizon, a grayish sky densely covered with white clouds. Painted with small but pastose brushstrokes.
5a2733709a15b9eb0870ef9ce03e5dc0fe1b2ec8: A seascape. In the foreground, on the left side, a dark patch of colour with orange tones. On the right side below, 3 separate dark patches of colour, one above another, resembling stones. Above on the right side, a blue patch of colour - i.e. the sea surface together with the sky. In the center of the picture, a pinkish, green surface reminiscent of a cliff or a large wave. Painted in a semi-abstract manner, blending colours with sweeping brushstrokes.
668258e1a34484a9134cc8a0f167dd42c04acb9d: 5 pen drawings on one sheet. 1. A tall, thin old woman, wearing glasses and holding a bouquet of flowers. 2. A barefoot boy, cap pulled deep over his head, sitting. 3. Two women, wearing hats, sitting. On the left the younger one, on the right the older and stouter one, with a masculine face. 4. A crying baby, with closed eyes and wide open mouth. 5. A man in a patched suit and checkered cap leaning on a handrail.
7f5e747f59cdc4bd650802716296c070624bbf68: Marju Bormeister (b. 1945 in Tallinn) graduated from the Estonian State Art Institute as a painter in 1985. As a descendant of artists, she has lived half her life in the Tallinn Art Hall, encountering early on the turpentine-scented world of paints. Bormeister especially likes to paint nature and the various surface structures found in it. As a technique, Bormeister particularly enjoys monotype
8c2f48e91ed22b209eb7b51fe81c2dd1f66641ed: Ivar Kaasik (b. 1965 in Kuressaare) is an Estonian painter and jewelry artist. Kaasik began his studies in the Department of Architecture at the Estonian State Art Institute, but graduated from the university as a metal artist. Since 1992, Kaasik has lived in Berlin. In 1989–1990, he studied at the Halle University of Art and Design in Germany. Since 2001, Kaasik has been a member of the German Association of Painters.
0e287acf484d3568ccc94b9276fa3d3c1a4f448b: Hermann von Kügelgen (1828-1897) was the youngest child of Carl and Emilie von Kügelgen. He was born in Estonia, studied at the Tallinn Cathedral School, and received an engineering education in Dresden. After the death of his first wife Emma, he married Johanna, daughter of the Tartu artist August Matthias Hagen. Kügelgen was a teacher at the Tartu Realschule and at the art courses of the German Craftsmen's Society. He died in 1897 in Tartu.
432de0e25a1acebda1bdf2364b92d0af8583f88b: Aliisa Ahtiainen is a Finnish visual artist working in Tallinn. She has earned a bachelor's degree in graphic art from the Estonian Academy of Arts, a bachelor's degree in Finnish literature from the University of Helsinki, and a master's degree in fashion studies from Stockholm University. In autumn 2026, she will begin master's studies in media art in fine arts at the Slade School of Fine Art at University College London.
d00a30c8fda21d0c9c2bc95cb62d4fca9a01a9b5: A decorative depiction of a car door viewed from inside the car. The overall shape of the door, marked on a white background with thick black rounded contours, the window latch, hinges, door handle, window crank, inner pocket, from which the corner of a magazine is visible with the text: NEW SP(EED). The door upholstery is a uniform light blue tone. The colours are applied from behind according to ready-made shapes. At the top right of the work, in black: "UKS"
58dd3afd0c8541a7434a124f6aec9ee6ea8d6515: From the left, one seated female figure with her back turned and one facing forward, nude, holding a red and a black piece of cloth respectively. On the right, a nude female figure standing in a quarter-turn with her back turned, holding a white cloth. Behind the seated women on the left and in the center, dark bluish-gray treetops, above a cloudy sky. The women's bodies and pieces of cloth are painted in a generalized manner, strongly emphasizing light and shadow.
f4c208c446065c8e73a710364b4e1df01eb2db4c: In the foreground on a snowy flat area, almost in the center, a gnarled leafless tree, to the right of it a footpath winding into the depth, on which, further away, a female figure holding a stick is visible in profile view. On the right edge of the picture, another leafless tree. Further away, against the background of a forest fading into dusk, two farmhouses with smoking chimneys can be seen, on whose snow-covered thatched roofs the glow of the rays of the setting sun shimmers.
b8142035882d2cd5b0f94b2d599769a6f18b5fcc: Avo Keerend (1920–2012) was an Estonian graphic artist and painter whose creative career spanned more than six decades. He began his art studies as early as 1936, initially focusing on graphic art, but later also developed his painting skills. In his earlier work, Keerend mainly used intaglio printing techniques, creating naturalistic still lifes, nudes, and genre scenes.
c07a1cb2126cd86b596fcb9a535e17394f592fcc: Toomas Rein (b. 1940) is an Estonian architect and watercolourist. He graduated from the Tallinn Polytechnic in industrial and civil construction and, in 1967, from the Faculty of Architecture of the Estonian State Art Institute. He received the grand prize at the Baltic Watercolour Triennial held in Riga in 1986. In 2011, director Peeter Brambat's film "Ehituskunstnik Toomas Rein" ("Architect Toomas Rein") was completed.
2526a3af5d63cbdd855e7bf4af8cf366bb12f798: Three standing figures, on the left a man without a headcover, wearing a coat, breeches, and high-legged footwear, his right hand at waist level, between the flaps of his coat, his left hand straight at his side; in the center a man with a headcover, dressed similarly to the previous one, in profile facing left, his left hand in his trouser pocket; on the right a woman, wearing a headscarf, a long coat, a skirt, and long-legged footwear, in three-quarter profile facing left, her hands in her pockets
28e4af6d6aea099815e0260ecb4388fe71015bbe: 4/5 of the upper part of the painting depicts a dense forest of bushes and trees, on the left a patch of sky visible between the treetops. In the foreground, at the edge of the forest, 9 people sitting-lying in a row: on the right a sitting and a lying female figure, in the center an accordion player wearing a hat, on the left four men and a woman. The painting is in greenish-brown tones, of varying texture, in places pastose, with scratched-in paint surface.
5dd214f9daa690bba208a67728bc99169f37df87: In the foreground on the left, on a rug spread on the sand, a small girl wearing a straw hat is playing, and next to her a dark-haired, barefoot girl doing needlework is sitting. Behind both of them, a boy in a white suit stands, holding flowers. In front of the group, partly visible in the right corner at the waterline, a barking dog. Further back, a thicket of deciduous trees, through which a path passes, showing two female figures in the background beyond it.
5e583d6b78eb5dac0c0e91c1b190307fd5155ef9: Lembe Ruben (b. 1974) graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in the field of graphic art. Master's degree in fine arts 2002. Wiiralt Young Artist Prize 2011. She has taught graphic art, drawing, and composition at the Estonian Academy of Arts and in hobby groups; designed and illustrated magazines and books; and has also engaged in animation, stage design, and exhibition curating.
aa6d6d8f7d0519f87ad9c5b02b0cbb6b1bb1d1fc: A figural composition with potato pickers in the foreground: three women dressed in dark clothing with headscarves stand, a fourth pours potatoes from a basket into a cart painted in the center of the picture, on whose bed a brown coat lies. To the left of the women, a man in dark clothes ploughs open potato ridges with a white horse. In the background, as if given through fog, a gray barn and solitary trees. The sky is leaden gray.
fa557b0195834fe1528e86f06b309075a9b52570: A view from above onto a street in purplish nightfall dusk. In front, tall trees, under them on the left reddish kiosks, an advertising post, silhouettes of solitary pedestrians on the pavement. Further back on the right, in front of a large light-colored building, three cars on the road. Further away, dark purple roofs, the glow of city lights. The painting is in a greenish-purple range, with an evenly smooth brush handling. (View from the window of the Art Hall onto Pärnu maantee).
5ddc9bcaf80ad1dd03b731a2272b758de25cf314: In light blue water with yellow, red, and purple horizontal streaks, in the middle ground from the left edge to the middle, an islet with lush vegetation and a tree with a sharp-tipped conical crown (on the left), two such trees. Behind it in the background, in the right golden section, another islet. The brownish-red sky on the right with a cloud of yellowish, purplish, and red pastose cross-hatching. Textured painting technique.
c47bfb1b4a00b862f1cc1d0fbe0ba5bb5588af9b: Full figure of a dark-skinned man with an aquiline nose, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, in three-quarter profile facing right. His attire consists of a coat with differently shaped breast sides and a jagged lower hem, trousers with legs of different colours, sharp-toed spurred boots with turned-down tops, and a wide "toga"-type cloak. His hands are gloved, the right resting on his hip, the left slightly extended forward holding a whip.
fb8a0f4683179275a63109f4853c70ffe5bb3bd9: A man with hair combed back over his head, wearing a work suit with long sleeves and trouser legs, breast pockets, and large pockets on the trouser legs, stands on a stepped stand. His left leg is straight, his right bent at the knee, resting on a higher step. His hands hold in front of him a welding unit with cables resting on a wooden step support, the cables of which extend from behind the man's back to the heel of his left leg
2bf5f612b05bcb6b9883809f835855bf55080e3d: An interactive video and sound installation. A video projection on the wall, in front of which stands a microphone. To activate the work, the viewer must sing or otherwise make a sound into the microphone. On the screen, a woman (Mare Tralla) in tight brightly coloured sportswear, who, reacting to the viewer's voice, begins to sing, move, and jump in various ways. In the background, the stage of the Tallinn Song Festival Grounds.
4b37d806f36c4a3cabf5653b68c8fef14b7ce6ab: In the foreground a village road turning to the right. Along the road a crossbar fence. Inside the fence two farm buildings from the middle of the painting to the right. In front of the buildings, in the middle-right, a well with a tall sweep and a diagonal wooden-pole fence. 1/2 of the painting's surface is sky with clouds. Behind the buildings, on the horizon, a spruce forest. Painted in bright tones - mainly purplish and grass-green pastose - with a palette knife.
887d50fba51944302bcf129fb567a7aae9194d8b: In the background the Order Castle in scaffolding. Workers are carrying logs to it along the middle road. On the left, large in scale, an armoured knight with a spear and shield, guarding the work. In the foreground three men are digging the ground. On the right three log buildings with thatched roofs and ridge-poles, a fourth log building being built. Bare ground and leafless trees. In the middle left two men are felling a thick tree. In front, tree stumps.
47f2f8c2097184fcdc70f4393eb9f8bd2c066f1b: In the foreground, oversized garden strawberries, cut-open fruit slices and a spotted cup with milk. On the right edge hang large black pear-shaped fruits. The still life is separated from the background landscape by a black band bordered by a yellow-green-yellow edging. In the landscape leafless trees, a house, a factory building under construction with tall smoking chimneys. The treatment is emphatically clear-lined.
9d1511ee84d56ecdf87238c09296e6006ade0458: In the foreground, a young man's knee-length figure in profile, leaning on a handcart loaded with colourful suitcases and bags. Dark hair, a regular Greek profile, face turned slightly toward the viewer. The young man wears a bright white shirt with black trousers. The man's right hand rests, bent, on the packages. The background is a bright blue sky ending in a red handrail, with a black and white rectangle.
cab2d4129cabe92d47a66cf8601818385da92ef1: On the left, on an even, light, greenish-grey surface, a window motif in a dark square. On the right, a brownish-grey surface. Between them a composition of abstract surfaces in red, blue, whitish and brown tones, out of which emerge: at the bottom edge the chest figure of a moustached man, to the right of it the face of an older woman, and above the full figure of a young woman. The paint surface is slightly fractured.
2deed65d3c6d4ee2fd51070e5302ada62f33629b: In the centre of the painting sits, on a red carved-legged chair, a man in grey fig-leaf trousers. The upper body is stylised, above the left shoulder a square of about 6.5x7 cm made of white pearls. The right arm straight at the side, resting on the chair. The walls, floor and ceiling of the room are in red-blue tones. In the upper left corner of the chair's blackish-red backrest are two darker profile-like patches.
71196f512e49413de06142c9fe16a5c0d21601a2: In the foreground below, two conversing figures: on the left a young man with brown hair in a dark blouse, right hand stretched out, on the right a fair-haired youth in a wine-red blouse. The chairs are mustard-coloured. In the background a geometric composition of complex structure made of stripes, circles, triangles and squares. White, grey, black and blue tones dominate, with a few bright accents.
c4d288c607bdced7a35e3bcb4e02b8780a7db474: An abstract painting predominantly on a white background, composed of coloured zigzag and free-hand lines, flat shapes with jagged edges, dots and stripes. In the upper half of the work runs a curving cobalt-blue jagged band with coloured dots, parallel to it a red ribbon. Below, a corner of blue-red-blackish shapes with black dots in a white frame.
5b9b1ddfbb4f889b9fa4ed2e0df4266995394485: View of Tallinn from Kalamaja seen from the sea side: in the foreground, at the bottom edge and on the right, reddish-brown broad-bottomed steamships, in the bottom left corner a quay with a few human figures and barrels. Beyond, the Old Town of Tallinn, above which rises St. Olaf's Church. Above, a purplish-grey, gloomy cloudy sky. Painted in dark grey and brown tones, the water surface in the foreground given pastose in places.
d3158938718b00e60088bbee1b96d5c0e389c22e: A two-part painting made of coloured geometric shapes. The shapes form planar and spatial structures, in which: in the lower right corner of the left-hand wing a sketched woman's face, through both wings, slightly below the horizontal centre line, runs a lower body in a lying position, in the upper right edge of the right-hand wing a woman's half-nude. The canvas surface is in places left uncovered by paint.
9929d07fec9215d3bdb1d0ef27e25c1edee12293: Began art studies under A. Kaigorodov. 1925-1929 studied sculpture at "Pallas". 1929-30 furthered his studies in painting and applied art in Paris at the Conservatoire National des Arts et Métiers. Sculptor, painter, applied graphic artist. Went to Germany in 1944, from 1947 lived in England, from 1952 in Toronto, Canada. Was a member of EKKKÜ in 1940 and a member of EKKT from 1961-85. Buried in Tartu.
1d84c2df9705ddfe7b25529dbb4dae68c61e1bc5: Born in Tallinn, studied ceramics 1947-49 at the Tallinn Institute of Applied Art and graphics 1949-53 at ERKI. Has worked as a teacher at the art academy, professor since 1992. Honoured Artist of the ESSR in 1965. One of the most outstanding, prolific and internationally best-known Estonian graphic artists, mainly in the field of intaglio printing. Has also created ex libris and illustrations, mostly for Estonian poems.
de2d09f611f19efa62aba9d0a205a68d58bc8cc9: Kati Müüripeal (1994) is a painter active in Estonia who has taken part in group exhibitions since 2019. As a teenager she acquired academic drawing skills from the animal painter Sándor Martin Sterl. She has now graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a BA in Fine Arts and an MA in Contemporary Art. During an exchange programme she furthered her studies at the University of Fine Arts Hamburg.
753162f2a5cd9529991c99a5ce7585dd98e5a4d2: Danel Ülper has graduated from the Pallas University of Applied Sciences. In his painting he focuses on the study of the interiors of historical buildings and is interested in architecture and the environment. Currently the artist is working with the border region of South Estonia and North Latvia, delving into the nature of the periphery both in his artistic work and by documenting the historical interiors of buildings at risk of destruction.
1f77d5ba8f3ea8db34d22d124d416d480acddc70: In front, in the middle of the painting, stands a girl reaching almost to the top edge of the picture, in profile to the right. The dress is dark, the apron light, the kerchief on her head blue. Behind the shepherd and on both sides light-coloured sheep. Below right, at her feet, flowers. In the background a strip of shore and beyond it a narrow body of water ending on the horizon in a forest. The horizon is very high. The surfaces are surrounded by dark contours.
fb0ef46fd338f00e03f272d732cd235f9efa323a: In the foreground, a meadow in cold green tones, with grass stalks painted in detail. At the bottom edge grey pipes winding out of the ground. In the middle of the picture, on the meadow, a construction of white cubes and vertical pipes. To the left of the construction two trees, to the right a single one. Behind the construction, on the horizon, a stretch of shrubbery. Above, purplish at the bottom, higher up a clearly blue sky with cumulus clouds.
2d939367bafe1a3239a8dbeb542ae80afaf156d2: In the foreground two women sitting side by side on a bench. The left one in half-profile to the left, head lowered, hands in her lap. The right one in frontal view, head lowered to the right, a headcover covering her eyes, left hand in her lap, right hand on her chest. On the ground beside them, on the right a travel bag, on the left an object resembling a stool. Behind, on the left the silhouette of a woman's half-figure in profile, and on the right, in frontal view, the silhouette of a woman's head and shoulders.
28e603f369ccb2d5f01e85c10ebf0afe133a0abe: Portrait of a fair-haired girl with long, beautifully curling locks, in a quarter-turn to the right. The girl has light blue eyes, a slightly upturned nose, a small beautifully shaped mouth. She wears a brown jumper, from whose collar the collar of a wine-red blouse shows. The background is in grey and beige tones. The paint surface is pastose in places, in the hair area lines have been drawn into the paint layer with the brush handle.
1ffe065df51d8586fbb3dc1297e5f80729e7730a: On the left, St. Nicholas' Church with its tower in scaffolding, in the middle a crane with a yellow cabin, behind it the cuboid building of the "Viru" hotel. In the foreground, against a wall backdrop, a yellow road roller and a piece of a red-and-yellow patterned fence. In the background a blue sky rendered in an angular manner with white clouds. Muted grey, green and blue tones dominate. The painting emphasises structure in its manner of execution.
a0abff83473b760a1d757a2232c93b1cd3adfa1c: Three-quarter figure of a fair-haired young woman in a pink dress, in frontal view, gaze directed slightly to the left. The woman has an oval face, green eyes, long hair in a teased hairstyle. The dress has three-quarter sleeves, a small slit at the neckline. The left hand is in her lap, the right rests on the other elbow. The background is a darker pink. The manner of depiction is conventional, painted in places with broad pastose palette-knife strokes.
3ddafb872ec1126be31a9c4d3740437a4a90653a: A night industrial landscape. On the left from the middle of the picture edge, and on the right from the upper corner, two large-diameter pipelines run to the horizon; in front, a thin dark blue pipe bent intricately around a black vertical stake. On the lower left, on the ground, a single red flame, further off four factory chimneys. In the middle of the horizon three horizontal green stripes. Above left, a full moon.
205ea586b9b13e237ef61ac8c298b2be69cc9af7: In the foreground a portrait in 1/4 view to the right; face in greyish-blue tones, a yellow and brown jerkin, right hand pressed down with fingers and an upright thumb; right eye squinting, negroid nose, thick blue lips; the cap red-striped; In the background above three figures left in light colour and a donkey; on the right in the middle a smaller laughing head with an open mouth wearing a red-and-blue patterned cap
73132d219570b3b15fcb0ac60d4cf1adf74ceac5: In the middle of the picture, on a table covered with a cloth, Mary holds the naked infant sitting on a cushion. The child looks calmly upward. A Jewish priest with a long beard, in a splendid coat and striped biretta, performs the circumcision. On the left, behind Mary, stands another woman, gaze directed downward. In the middle, behind, a bearded man - Joseph. On the right another bearded man holds the hem of the coat.
c3bf211057447628806fad8adaf24c087f6dd985: A landscape of large natural boulders, with ruins of a building with round-arched openings and cylindrical vaults. On the left in front, a heap of boulders. In the foreground a shepherd with a hat sits on the ground, beside him a dog. In front two more cows, on the right further back also two cows. In front of the ruins three sheep graze on grass. On the right, on the horizon, a mountain peak, in front of it hills with forest and a town-like settlement.
e90a0900a48277a2a5fd9a9e023de2549b464826: Studied at Võru Gymnasium, 1928-30 and 1934-1939 in Tartu, at the art school Pallas, which he graduated from as a graphic artist. In 1942 he won the I prize in the Education Directorate's design competition for the design of the print series "Lõuna-Eesti inimene ja loodus" [South Estonian man and nature]. On 21.09.1944 he went into exile, lived in various DP camps in Germany, in 1949 moved to the USA. He directed the Estonian Cultural Fund in New York from 1958-1973
cc3563a873384549c521ae5016440dbdd77eafdb: A table with a light brown top and slightly darker legs, seen from above. On the table, objects given from different perspective angles: a bluish-white and yellow plate, a green and red sphere. In the background on the right, a window opening in a pale green frame, in which a wine-red sphere. Light blue balls are visible through the window. The background is a soiled green tone at the bottom, bordeaux red at the top left.
dc3eb4d8f74f59db9e65b35c1292506e4312d4a5: The centre of the picture is occupied by the figure of a young woman in a blue robe, sitting sideways to the viewer in a boat. From her outstretched right hand, whitish flowers are falling into the water. Her left hand is raised to her shoulder holding one flower. Beside the woman in the boat, a large bunch of flowers. In the background, blurred silhouettes of two boats and people. Painted in blue, yellow, whitish tones; contours blurred.
f055438041ce2b78a64b2acc14aef4c1d13db186: In an interior, on a black background, in the centre, stylised with white lines, the figure of a seated woman in profile facing left, head in profile facing right, left hand resting bent at the elbow on the armrest of the seat. Upper left, a bust portrait, in frontal view, of a man sitting behind a table. On the table a carafe, a goblet and a vase. Lower right, on a square-shaped surface, a footed dish with fruit, a knife and a handled vase.
e846a38271662797f44da8cbd69b5de55cdd18bc: In the centre, a young woman lying on two light blue pillows. The woman has mahogany-coloured hair, wears a pink-and-black patterned dress that leaves her back bare, legs crossed, hands on knees, in her left hand a book with red covers, gaze directed at the viewer. In front of the bed a round low table on which a brown ceramic vessel with a handle. The background is painted through with dense brushstrokes, mainly in bluish-grey tones.
1f3f6d7037553509aa22fb7d0425138db85ab80f: Knee-length portrait of a seated girl in a slight turn to the right. The girl has a red ribbon in her dark hair, wears a white shirt, a blue dress and a purplish-red vest. The girl's right hand rests in her lap, the left near her hip. In the lower right corner a bowl with fruit, in the upper corner a brownish patterned jug with a large bouquet of flowers. On the left, the background merges into browns, beiges, bluish tones blending into one another.
dafebe6a0b027049daddcd464ff556c5490d6ac9: In the corner of a room with grey walls sits a girl in a reddish-brown dress with a white apron, on a dark chair. The girl's hair is straight and falls to her ears, her hands rest side by side in her lap. The girl wears black stockings and shoes, her gaze with sad eyes directed at the opposite corner. To the right of the girl, part of a table pushed against the wall is visible, above which a picture presumably hangs on the wall.
64a7b498f3e73e0c87e8870d844a76d2b7851ad8: In the foreground a rye field, crossed in the middle by a road leading into the depth. In the middle ground, deciduous trees on both sides of the road. On the right side of the road, in the foreground, a load of rye with a man in a hat on top. Further away on the right, on a field half covered by growing rye, a load of rye with a horse walking toward the road; on the left a haystack. In the middle of the painting, mountains covered with bluish forest are visible between the deciduous trees.
8f34fda1b4120b9f4f0fc371d5ff380958ba05fa: The naked Christ child lies on a bed covered with linen, his upper body resting on a pillow. He reaches out his arms toward his mother, who has lifted the cover from him. Mary looks at the child with a devout expression, holding the cover with both hands. On the left in the background stands the bearded Joseph, leaning with both hands on a long staff and likewise looking at the child. Both Mary's and Joseph's heads shine with a halo. The background is a dark drapery.
7beaad58696546ffe8bc8913be23639ffd23444d:
Ülle Meister was born 27. VIII 1948 in Lüganuse, died 6. I 2021 in Tallinn. 1967-1973 studied graphic art at ERKI (EKA), graduated as a book graphic artist. Her diploma work was a primer that was used in schools for many years. She then worked at the publishing house Valgus.

Ülle Meister has designed record sleeves and postcards, created ex libris, and worked in free graphic art and watercolour.
b47808b15e1b8a11e30639919560e465331ad3c8: Kärt Hammer (1988) has studied philosophy (BA 2011) and cultural theory (MA 2014) at Tallinn University and in her work has dealt with the paradox of the possibility and impossibility of interpreting a work of art. Hammer is an interdisciplinary artist who in her creative work mainly focuses on purely aesthetic and intuitive abstraction, avoiding excessive textuality.
f1b9b15a7200e574a786ca22248dd28dfa8e50d2: An interior view, mixed up with a work room. Objects scattered on the floor of the room: in the foreground a light blue shopping bag and a table drawer, behind them loose papers, notebooks and playing cards. In the background a writing desk, a shelf, a cabinet with an open door and a chair, objects on all surfaces. The painting finished in aerosol technique and by dripping paint, a colour chart painted in the upper left edge.
a1aed54b4b6c62f7f2defd2988bdde90930d6bd3: A semi-abstract composition of geometric shapes and landscape motifs: upper left an object resembling an arched bridge against the background of a distant bluish-green landscape. On the right pink, green, black colours, more painterly surfaces at the top. The lower part of the painting mainly consists of clearly bounded, mostly sharp-angled geometric surfaces in whitish and muted tones.
d160c358f0120efde1a24e289356b7145a893e1f: A young, naked woman's more or less painted-out breast area and, as if in defence, an outstretched left hand with spread fingers. Light hair around the arm. The outstretched right forearm is visible up to the elbow, which extends into the lower left corner of the picture. The woman's face is sketched with light charcoal lines. The upper half of the canvas is a bare ground. In the painted-out area a dark background is given.
d8298df92f8ee43c08657c6090c33c1abae9f18f: On the left in electric blue and on the right in red tones, against a background painted in pink tones with the silhouette of a yellow hand, an over-life-size face of a young man, in a half-turn to the left. The gaze of the bright blue eyes, set far apart, is directed at the viewer. Full lips show through between the yellowish-brown moustache and the chin beard. Reddish-brown wavy surfaces at the edge of the ear.
a269bafd92b88e7ab5e55071961a55c97d0b8f65: A print with a view of Jaani Street and the main building of the University of Tartu. In the foreground, on a cobblestone-paved street, students in uniforms, gentlemen in top hats and ladies. High walls with wide niches on both sides of the street. On the left a row of houses, opposite which the university with its facade of six columns. Above, in the triangular pediment, the Russian imperial symbol, the double-headed eagle.
0aaf7a2f56dac9fa75ce2cf8804668c505b8fb77: Studied at the State School of Applied Arts in the years 1924-1930. Furthered his studies in the years 1931-1932 in the master class of the Leipzig State Academy for Graphic Arts and Book Design. He then taught for a long time at the State Industrial School. In 1944 he obtained a teaching position at the Estonian SSR State Institute of Applied Arts, where he became head of the graphic art department (docent 1946, professor 1952) and remained in this position until 1982.
ece8999c6001f1f96f739a07b8ecf6b95e6c1530: Liisa Jugapuu (b. 1990) obtained a bachelor's degree in painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts, and is currently pursuing master's studies in the same field. She has taken part in organising exhibitions curated by Vano Allsalu, organised the ERKI Moeshow, and as an intern represented Dénes Kalev Farkas's exhibition "Evident in advance" at the Venice Biennale in 2013.
a948e4efbc4473c9e1fad413b930f912d566ab8d: A folk festival scene. In the centre a midsummer bonfire, in the foreground two accordion players and a dancing couple in folk costume, other dancers behind them. On the left in the middle of the picture a tug-of-war, on the right in the lower corner two seated old men (one of them with a pipe). Behind the old men two women and a man conversing. In the background a nocturnal forest. Greenish-grey colouring with reflecting glimmers of fire. On the right, people on swings.
629049905dbe86d3c0c5402ad078211ad4ce6b1b: In the centre, behind a table, seated on the left a man with his right hand on the table, and on the right a woman in a headdress, both hands on the table, gazing in profile down to the left. The man in frontal view. In front of them on the table two vessels. Behind the man and woman, a man's head in profile facing right. On the far right stands a woman in a headdress and long garments, in profile facing left, hands on her stomach. On the left, in the corner, a jug and a bowl on a table.
630a8098fceab88818df6e4dfcae4cfb37d418d3: In a suggested interior, in the centre a female figure seated on a flat base, in profile facing left, legs stretched forward, left hand resting behind her back on the ground, right hand in her lap in front, behind on the left a man's half-figure in frontal view resting on his right hand, on the right behind a three-quarter figure of a seated man in frontal view, upper left in the distance two suggested human figures, lower right two suggested male heads with headdresses.
1c39f8bc3c1a5a6c0d0d5ff3015de80fa86436a2: A landscape painting - Lake District - in a warm lilac-yellowish colouring, a central place - a lake in the middle of the picture, running through - in a dark lilac tone. On the horizon - in the distance, clumps of forest in lilac tones. In the foreground on the right, clumps of forest. In the foreground on the right, a poison-green house with a pink roof and a tall chimney. In the middle of the picture at the bottom, two spruces side by side. Painted in a generalised manner, without significant detail.
ecb8c9441b3e4e56de62f84b952a4908fc481d6b: Multicolour print (black, grey, yellow, red, purple). In the upper part of the poster, faces depicted with stylised musical instruments. Text: Lembit Saarsalu kvintett. Lembit Saarsalu- saksofonid; Margus Kappel- klahvpillid; Toivo Unt- bass; Andrus Vält- löökpillid; Paul Mägi- viiul. ENSV Riiklik Filharmoonia. The lower part of the poster is white (space for the time and place of the performance).
b85910f22a759e02c54fc76f2f66a6bce6940502: The picture shows a factory room. In the foreground on the right a man in a peaked cap and camouflage-coloured work clothes at a workbench, sleeves rolled up. Further back the silhouette of a man working at another workbench. In the background a large window made of small squares, through which a light blue automobile is visible. Two massive crane hooks and wires hang from the ceiling. The whole picture in bluish-grey colour tones.
7b19002d31bb22405e1b88c1b7ba8a9baba551a7: Abstract, yellow rounded shapes in several tones. In the middle left a large irregular black blotch, vertical. Lower right a similar motif in whitish-yellow tone. In the upper and lower parts of the painting, dark-coloured, occasionally impasto "comb" traces. In the centre a horizontal asymmetrical shape in yellow tones. The painting has a hovering, flowing mood, reminiscent of microorganisms.
e7b8b689ae7800ea3fb77d2bfc8a22ca7ca99600: A clean-lined oval face of a teenage girl with low cheekbones; free forehead, arched eyebrows, open eyes with modelled eyelids, a straight nose and full lips. The LONG hair is parted across the whole head, the braids begin behind the ears on both sides of the head, reaching to the shoulders. Shoulders narrowly cut, the base of the bust narrow, square in front
0bc0545dc4078c4dcf6c535473ee1c951f99404a: Bust figures of three girls against a background of high blue sky with a low horizon. On the left, in half-profile to the right, a long-haired blonde in a green jumper with a round wide neckline; in the centre, in half-profile to the left, a chestnut-brown brunette in a red jumper with a square wide neckline; on the right, in profile to the left, an auburn-haired girl ["šatään"] in a white jumper with a square, dark-edged neckline.
7c9a8d1378de1596e29a235a3d0989ec0716a774: In the foreground, against a background of grass painted as a monochrome bright green surface, a red-yellow striped barrier pole, raised on the right side. Beyond it, forest as an even band. Above it, sky, on which a large yellowish-black cloud of smoke stretches diagonally from the left corner to the right across the whole sky as a wide band. Below the cloud the sky is painted as an even light blue surface, above the cloud as a dark blue surface.
5f41a199f25b025327f38e27aec1ac975d46b7c7: A composition in brown tones: in the left corner, a peasant man sitting and another standing in front of him (both wearing hats and long coats). Beyond, on the left, a grey well, to the left of which is a trough and a piece of pole fence. By the well sits a woman in a bonnet-shaped hat, and next to her, with his back to the viewer, stands a man in a brown jerkin. Farm buildings are given sketchily in the background. Above, a blue cloudy sky.
097af4fce15e05ca9384f8df142dc34c6f8c56bc: On a rocky coast, on the right, a small elevation with the ruins of a castle. Behind the castle, the roof of a more distant house is visible. In front, on the right, fishing nets hung out to dry. Around the castle, a pasture fence. On the left, a shallow bay inlet, in which the ruins are reflected. In front, a couple of larger stones, further back a solitary sailboat. Above the landscape, the sky is evenly light blue, with a pale yellow sun setting.
f2597c917db77d1e8687dcf2885f66265a9b4ad3: In the foreground on the left, the corner of a farm building with an open door, with arrowheads beside and in front of the door. In front of the building on the left, a male figure in peasant dress drawing a bow. To his right, a standing peasant figure equipped with a sword. In the centre right, a man with a bow over his shoulder and arrows in hand, his back to the viewer. Behind, on the right, the corner of a farm building and a tall gate with a larger group of male figures.
efab8be5aca0738f1a636873a02a69001fea62c7: In a dim room, a young man making music at a piano, seen in side view, hands on the keys, head turned towards the viewer. The man has a rounded forehead, slightly bulging eyes. A light-coloured collar shows beneath the dark jacket. The interior background is painted with broad, mechanical, precise strokes imitating the flickering glow of an orange lamp standing on the piano. Predominantly dark bluish-purple, greenish poisonous tones.
4e8ee94ef386ba038711a1c3bb0b5d37e1c34dad: A winter landscape traversed by valleys, with a high horizon (the sky taking up 1/3 of the picture surface). In the foreground, from left to right, a horse vigorously pulling a log sledge, followed on the road and further back by other sledges. On the right, beside the sledge, a man walks holding the reins with his right hand and the load with his left. In the left foreground, a telephone pole with a short support. In the middle ground on the right, in the valley, two buildings.
c6269d9d53c556b0d2278f04de04025e701b371b: A biblical scene of the Virgin Mary with the Christ Child against the background of an expansive landscape. Mary is shown as a half-figure, her body turned half-way to the right, her face en face. Her expression is calm, her gaze lowered, her smooth hair parted, her robe leaves the neck bare, a light veil thrown over her head. The Christ Child is naked in his mother's arms, the child looks straight ahead, leaning with his left hand on his mother's breast, his body turned to the left.
75aa9b4826f3b99af081b4a492372a5d596b35ff: In the foreground, a water surface, from which a wide stone staircase with low steps rises up to the street.
