In the upper left corner a green patch of forest. The white and yellow are painted very impastoly.
6ff5db7f4bcf8663a9cd920a54956f1ffe680875: A photo installation on a tall five-legged light wood construction. The photo shows an empty living room with white walls and a wooden parquet floor, in the corner of which, standing on its hind legs like a bear, is a pile of various objects, consisting of a coffee table turned on its side, a stool placed on top of it, and two coffee cups attached to the stool along with a corded table lamp.
93e4d539c4539f596bca2de5dd8d303346fd41b0: A composition in an interior, at the centre of which is a still life leaning on a stool leg, a small garden, a closed box, a corded package and a small table. On the small table a deodorant bottle spraying into the air and an object resembling a table mirror. On both sides of the still life, a branch on a forked leg, to which are attached picture fragments, bits of wire, a plant leaf and an abstract element.
82483bd005fb5b4e0df449b7b000686372247df7: In the foreground on the left, on the beach sand, large salmon and large fish crates. In the middle, a fishing boat full of fish washed up on the shore. Men and women busying themselves by the boat. Further back on the left, behind filled fish crates, dried nets; on the right on a jetty, fishing implements; behind the jetty a man is pulling a boat into the sea. Further back on the left a forested shore and on the right the open sea.
60fab2f54def9b8f99800736cde47ccc5ddf2873: An octagonal, 4 cm thick plate, painted on both sides in blue, red and green tones, with geometric surfaces. On one side an octagonal meander motif, clearly delineated, of coloured stripes. On the other side an octagonal star, formed of coloured triangles against a bluish-grey background. The sides are monochrome, bluish-grey.
12482cefd800746f523ff30143c064b4b59363ab: In the corner of a room with grey walls, a brown square stool with a beige towel on it, a white enamel bowl with a black rim, behind which stands a bulbous, thin-necked, almost full water bottle. Next to the bottle and bowl in the foreground two onions with green stalks (the stalks hanging over the edge of the stool), in the background a large green cabbage head. Behind the stool on the right a white enamel bucket.
19d6fef8be83ede6538ba3ce7e247027a540a469: Against the background of a brownish plank wall, a fair-haired girl with braids sits in a frontal view, hands in her lap. The figure is cropped at knee level. The girl has a serious expression, her brown-eyed gaze directed forward to the right. Dark bows in her braids, a black tie at the neckline of her large-collared light summer dress. In the background on the right a bluish fabric. Painted colourfully, softly modelled with light and shadow.
5c2049de213ebb504ed07789ab0b5c4c5c29ce2f: A view from a window into a room. In front on the left, on a green windowsill, an egg-shaped vase in brownish and reddish tones; in the middle ground, in profile in the golden section to the right, a pale woman with hair combed back to the nape, wearing a necklace. On the right a dark curtain in multi-coloured shades. In the background draperies and geometric colour surfaces arranged in the shape of a window frame.
75fa678c879a32ad14f924106b115d6c83c871fb: The artist sits on a red chair, slightly turned to the right. Gaze directed at the viewer, the hand holding a cigarette rests on the knees. The artist is wearing a wine-red coat, a greyish-blue shirt, dark trousers. On his head a black beret, from under which steel-grey hair shows near the ears. Behind him an ochre-yellow wall, on the left edge an easel with a blank canvas or sheet of paper.
72044cdcc97cde569acff5d316452587691c81c1: A half-length figure of a middle-aged man of strong build. A face with strong features, bags under the eyes, gaze directed into the distance, head turned 1/4 to the left; hair combed back over the head; the top two buttons of his collared dress shirt open, long sleeves with cuffs and cufflinks; the right hand bent, fingers holding a pencil, the left hand bent forward at waist level
67a1ac40f2dab3e99a89164e19e9efa1087a4260: A night-time waterside city view, with lit buildings and a pyramid in the background on the left, water in the foreground on the left and a railway station with a rail junction on the right. The colour scheme is dark, nocturnal. The work belongs to the series "Aidu Pyramids", in which Kadarik-Tüür Arhitektid sketch a future use for the deposition area of the Aidu oil shale quarry in the form of a parking-city built of pyramids made from stone waste.
290af9fec8439676f3970e30cb3dbbfc50adc9ef: A plan of the town of Keila, with street names, some buildings, drawings of buildings above, portraits, and explanations of numbers on the left side. Around the plan's frame, on both sides, explanatory text and drawings with corresponding numbers. Designed and executed by Olev Soans, compiled by Aivar Põldvee, with contributions from Kerttu Soans, Argo and Urmo Vaikla, consultation by Heldur Tibbing
4ec0cf5aff685d1eac1a9a72a16ea6272f519799: Martin Lazarev (b. 1977 in Tartu) has studied furniture design, wood restoration and classical drawing at the Tartu Art College. The artist has studied photographic art within the framework of courses at the Tartu Art College, but has mainly acquired his knowledge on his own, through practice. His working life has brought Lazarev together with several different design and advertising agencies.
da4d53057de7d59bd186fa44f446cb6f66c1cbf8: On a blackish-green background, slightly below the centre line, there is a row of vegetables and apples hanging on branches. Behind it on the left, a young woman with bared shoulders in a half-turn to the left. The woman has chestnut-brown shoulder-length hair, a slightly open mouth, wide-open eyes. In the upper right quarter, between trees, a farmhouse between the blue sky and bright green ground, in front a man with a dog.
bb3fc806fc94a98c756d9d66e5b13724e689330f: The painted surface is divided into two by a light horizontal line. In the upper part, against a light background, the bust of a girl whose long hair falls onto her shoulders, head lowered, gaze directed at an amaryllis flower, is located in the centre. On either side of the girl, the heads of two girls, of whom the facial part of one (left) is visible. In the lower part, a dark blue painterly surface. At the bottom edge, orange-blue.
504b0cb5d4f5bf61ec0a8900a760ff53ec137c0c: On the left, a young woman standing by the stove is stirring in a steaming pot with a ladle in her right hand, while placing a white jar on the edge of the stove with her left. The woman is wearing a dress with shoulder straps, a headscarf on her head. Behind, a window with three panes, a potted plant on the windowsill, a stool on the right. Painted airily and in a generalised manner in a light bluish-grey colour scheme, in places scratching into the paint layer.
59ba1ded71214b335bae3503ad06e5a610154b8c: In the foreground, a woman with a mournful expression in a long greenish-grey dress, a dark shawl tightly wrapped around her head. In her left hand a light-coloured jug with a slender neck, resting by its rim on an ochre-coloured wooden bench. On the left, behind the woman's back, a table covered with linen, on the right the outlines of a house. In front of the house, a tree bent into a curve, with sparse foliage. On the ground in front of the bench with the jug, some fruit.
412a0841308cf632d3458574706853344f5d724c: Full-length portrait of a young man in a grey suit, with light-coloured hair and beard, wearing glasses. Behind the glasses, grey-blue eyes look directly at the viewer. The background is grey, in the middle of the right-hand edge three yellow squares, and above that an abstract combination of colour patches in red tones. The suit is painted with lush brushstrokes, as bright patches of colour.
dd9d366d4331744c4f9fb52c8c546f858f92da98: Under a light blue sky with a delicate purplish tinge, a bay of a southern sea. In the foreground a light-coloured beach, by the sea two women standing naked, further away on the right two seated figures. On the right of the picture a tall leafy tree, bushes. On the other side of the bay, a flat mountain covered with low trees. On the horizon, purplish mountain ridges. Painted with short brushstrokes, more impasto in the foreground.
89d1c55ba7906a70d200acf669ff2e6c4e3bccb8: A horizontally lying female nude in profile, carved into the surface of the wood and covered with paint. The head on the right, tilted slightly backward. The left leg bent at the knee, the right leg straight. The lower half of the work is red, the upper black. In the woman's colouring, pink, yellow and light blue flecks dominate. Above the woman, a cloud-like form with triangular jagged edges.
b2108d28bf67aabe2195d5d7bb08288e9476d22c: On the right, a fisherman's hut with a pitched roof, in front of it a tall flagpole with a weather vane. In front of the hut stands a woman with two children (one of them in her arms), a little further forward three men. In the left foreground, large stones with tree branches, behind them a shore lined with stones, tall trees and fishermen's huts. In the distance, the silhouette of Tallinn – mainly Toompea with a castle and Tõnismägi (with a windmill).
d18f8f3aff54a496bb57d2813198b7d64dcc7a73: Two flat parallelepipeds stained dark brown, partially overlapping each other, glued together to form the centre of the composition; onto them, in turn, are glued parallelepipeds of varying sizes stained a lighter colour, one on each side, at the centre. The composition in turn stands on a coarse wooden base stained dark, which in turn rests on a parallelepiped, beneath which a darker parallelepiped
ea01de6947366fecbfdee2f7cd1c6e69085765ad: A group photo of the EÜS. A number of old and young men, some in coloured caps, standing against the background of the EÜS house. In the foreground, three men sitting on the steps, the middle one in a coloured cap and sash, with white gloves in his hand. Beside him two old men. Behind the middle, younger man, two more young men in coloured caps and sashes. In the right edge of the photo, two young men, the one on the right holding a flag.
afa40a3cb24889f8887c821a674c8cf92a8ed3a9: In the foreground, kneeling under tropical trees, three men: on the left a boy on the verge of manhood with clasped hands and striped trousers, in the middle a grey-haired old man with arms crossed, a cane resting on his knee, and to his right a black man with a basket on his back and a drink bottle at his belt. In front on the left, a dog is sniffing. In the background on the left, a church with a low open bell tower can be seen, its door open.
007171d45d73063614bb1935ad6cc7d703ea6448: Boris Kumm (1 September 1897, Pärnu – 21 November 1958, Tallinn) was a politician of the Estonian SSR, one of the main executors of Stalinist terror policy in Estonia, from 1941 People's Commissar of the People's Commissariat for State Security of the Estonian SSR (after the war Minister of the Ministry of State Security of the Estonian SSR until 1950). In 1945 he received the rank of Soviet major general.
5de6903d6e5b158b21285651d037e401a290bfa6: Jüri Kass (1956) is an Estonian artist. He graduated from the Estonian State Art Institute in industrial art (1979). He has worked as a graphic designer, painter, printmaker, and teacher. He has taken part in exhibitions since 1974. He has held about ten solo exhibitions (posters, drawings, paintings, prints). Joint exhibition "Vüüming" with Ülle Marks at the Kunstihoone gallery (2016).
c8674b8f2a34a4c9a6e429366343336ce5e29a2f: 3 pictures on the sheet. The first picture is a half-title for canto XII of "Kalevipoeg". In the foreground, three sons of the sorcerer. In the background, spruce trees. The middle picture is a half-title for canto XIX of "Kalevipoeg". In the foreground a man sits, on the right two seated women. Behind them, couples dancing. At the end of a pole, a tar barrel is burning. In the third picture, a man lies on the ground, arms crossed on his chest. Beside him stands a woman.
ea1a246a7482b0013cbdc9d237d1a30ce85e6c2f: On a deep brown background, a tabletop with objects: in front on the left a dark candlestick, two coconuts and two lemons. On the right a coconut and two sea shells, one cone-shaped, the other spiral-shaped with a pink interior. Behind on the left a copper jug and a pot with handles. Among the objects a cloth with a blue border stripe and a dried branch. The painting is in muted greyish-brown tones.
20eaf07d755431d3e9614f435686ea61395aa733: A view from below of three towers and a church of the old town, whose tips converge toward the centre of the picture. In the middle a depiction of a farmhouse, on both sides depictions of tall buildings, from which, in turn, two open books project and converge toward the centre of the picture on each side. Above the farmhouse an hourglass framed by a horseshoe, with trees on either side of it. At the bottom centre, the inscription: EX LIBRIS UUSI RAUKAS
a6039d67121e94b4f76caad0bf3bc35cbe3e148c: In the centre, on a large scale, a female figure in a long robe in a slight turn to the left, breasts bared. Beside her on the right, three heads one above the other. On the left, a female figure with round glasses in a long robe sitting on a chair, in profile to the left, head straight. Behind her back three faces. From the upper left edge, another head can be seen. These figures are surrounded by various signs and lines
7e85c7e7613cb3ac22cebbfb3ce085694628552a: A two-part spatial composition. Pieces of predominantly bronze-coloured plastic sheet, metal parts, a piece of blue rope and similar object details are attached to a base covered with partially crumpled and torn, colourfully overpainted paper. The attached material is arranged on the base in steps: at the bottom on the left edge, horizontally in the middle of the surface, and at the top on the right edge.
a7d66009ae21b221b9d854607043170179b6bc17: A multi-figure composition, at the centre of which Christ lies in a manger, beside him the seated Mary. At the head and foot of the manger, an ox and a donkey. In the middle on the left, three wise men approaching Christ. On the right edge stands a shepherd with a horn. In the lower part of the icon, two scenes with saints. In the upper part, on the left and right, angels, in the centre a depiction symbolising the Holy Spirit.
995e5b27534c793f9de2600c903ebd3a17bab0d7: A female figure sitting on an elevation on a base, upper body leaning forward. The left leg bent at the knee, the foot resting on the elevation, the toes touching the base. The right leg is stretched forward, slightly bent at the knee, both arms are stretched forward, the hands holding the foot around it. The back is very vividly modelled, the ribs sharply delineated.
33cb5f79ba4c991dd288cc333e87e93ee34c6392: After graduating from the Art Academy (1978), Kelli Valk has been active with exhibitions both in Estonia and abroad, holding solo exhibitions and participating in numerous joint projects in the art of printmaking. Her works, both in free graphic art and in book graphic art, have been noted with awards, and her works belong to the collections of several museums internationally.
7756338fd89d18da0379dd39e523c5983b205d90: In an interior, around a carved table, three men in monks' robes. The clean-shaven man on the left points into the book in front of him, while the monk on the right side of the table, with a long white beard, who has been writing, explains something, his left hand raised upward in a gesturing position. The third, young man, sits behind the table in a pensive pose, his head resting on his right hand.
2d94b05befa696e4a2efaf1788f9d60dc4c7824a: As an almost abstract combination of colour patches, in the foreground a girl in a blue skirt, yellow blouse, with a green face and purplish-red hair is playing the guitar. In the lower foreground edge, outstretched hands drawn in black. To the right and left of the middle-ground figure, other girls can be sensed. The background is a combination of abstract colour surfaces.
4e4b4462cf8348faa8c36c5435e241b3bf729dc1: In the centre of the picture, two female figures – one sits on her heels, upper body bent backward, the other kneels, holding something raised to eye level. Above on the right, the full figure of a man in a stooped position, head on his hands. Below on the right, a woman with a child, on the left the figure of a young man, head lowered onto his shoulder. The colouring is dark – brown, green tones. The central figures are in a slightly brighter colour scheme.
0ecc66c89e212c7a1a5ce5a0ca53db24433901fc: Portrait of a dark-haired young man sitting behind a balustrade in the foreground and leaning with his left forearm on the balustrade, facing left; head in half-profile to the left. A book between his hands. Low beret with a page hairstyle. Background of column architecture and a landscape visible through a window opening. On the right at the edge of the balustrade a medallion with, arranged in a circle, MDX AXXV DOMINICUS
8d4bc5f0311a4b4d5f03540c5c72ffefadf078a7: Five women in floral dresses sit at a coffee table in a bright, old-fashioned interior. Table set for six. Finely patterned service, white coffee pot. On the table a footed dish with a cake. A dark rose in a glass vase. The photo imitates the mood of the 1930s. Mount of grayish cardboard, with a rounded-corner opening. Gilded inner edge on the black frame, with traces of fly dirt.
bdf30513510af620af456aa094586825012ad624: The sound installation consists of five torpedo-shaped objects placed on metal stands. The torpedoes are installed together with a ventilation system located behind the objects. The torpedo-shaped objects produce a pulsating sound according to the rotation speed of the impellers. The rotation speed is adjusted with a regulating valve located in the ventilation duct.
3b7a3386f643f960f266040ef245f855267fe677: 20th map of the series "Eesti kultuurilooline piltatlas" [Cultural-Historical Picture Atlas of Estonia], with the outline of Estonia in the centre of the sheet, the map bordered by a row of images depicting, in separate ovals, various architectural monuments of Estonia, also portraits of persons at the edge of the map, symbols, explanatory text outside the map in Estonian, Russian, English, French and German, additionally drawings at the bottom on the sides.
199e4c3bd9157eb99b1b805be7f12ba1a58db571: Mother Emma (née Schippang) died in 1871. Erich grew up at Põlula manor in the family of Johanna (née Hagen) and Hermann von Krause (Erich's cousin's son). When the First World War broke out he was deported to Volgodas in Russia, where he worked as a doctor; in 1915 he was exchanged for Russian doctors held as prisoners of war and sent to Germany, where he worked in prison camps. In 1924 he married the nurse Hannelore Schorsecki.
93c7102295890a15293ca8110930f6b9bc1f9dbb: Against the background of a dark blue starry sky, beside an anvil with wavy flames, stands a young man with legs apart, seen frontally. In his raised left hand he holds a five-pointed star, his right hand with a hammer ready to strike. The man has long light hair down his back, wears a light shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a knife at his belt, and bast shoes on his feet. Predominantly bright blue and yellow tones, decorative manner of depiction.
e7b61d752fccace975697f269916323c0cb9d3d8: Triptych of a woman's portrait, fruits and flowers. On the left-hand section a fly on a dark background with a greenish tinge. On the middle section flowers and spotted fruits on a dark background with a greenish and reddish tinge. On the right-hand section a woman in a dark blue blouse, with short hair and red lips, against a red background, before her spotted fruits, a flower bloom and a fly.
6d15711d9d5b6e7cf5128601275dea2e5ba59529: On a seaside platform with a wooden barrier, leaning against the barrier log, stands L. Koidula looking out to sea. In her right hand a sheet of paper with the writing Коллом, in her left hand a parasol. She is bareheaded, curly hair falling onto her shoulders. A ruffled jabot is fastened with an Estonian brooch. Waves on the water's surface, further away a two-masted sailboat. Dark cloud banks in the sky.
4e01c11e6a851e41c93e496c2d70f721593473d0: Two rows of concrete salting basins run the length of the room. The left-hand middle basins are covered with wooden lids. Women are working by the two rearmost ones. On the left, by the edge of the basins, 6 closed wooden barrels. The sloping ceiling of the room is supported by a construction of forked supports. In the back on the left, one woman by the barrels. The rear wall of the room is made of glass.
8faf7eb49a63f33fb45b5263297530bfdb9767e1: born at Vahi manor in Tartumaa, studied 1907–1909 in Kristjan Raud's studio in Tartu, in 1909 at Anton Ažbé's art school in Munich, 1910–1913 at the École des Beaux-Arts and free academies in Paris, in 1919 at Pallas and 1922–1923 at the Hamburg School of Applied Arts. Was a founding member of the art society Pallas. Was mobilized into the Red Army; his date of death in 1943 is unknown
dbd89199247c3b15d2dba2f9e7cfac43843deba4: Eveli Varik has graduated from the graphic art department of the Estonian Academy of Arts. Has also studied design and spatial design. Has gained recognition as an interior and object designer. Has curated and designed exhibitions since 1999. Varik worked for nine years as chief artist and gallerist at Rakvere Theatre. Currently a teacher of the history of style and elective subjects at Tartu Art School.
37517d9c19863df458e3bf3762d816eff9e6e7af: In the foreground, large in the centre, the passenger ship "Georg Ots", entirely white with a blue stripe on the side. In front of the ship, partly obscuring it with its enormous wings, a gull dives with outstretched legs and open beak. The water and sky surrounding the ship and the gull are alike greenish-blue. The gull's plumage and the foamy wave crests are painted pastosely in white paint.
aaeb55541ded2fccec7653f4c107cd42355d8c1c: On top of a small cabinet a glass jar with various flowering plants and herbs. The jar with the plants is reflected on the cabinet top. The background is beige, in places the surface of the cardboard is left uncovered with paint. Behind the plants a rectangle is marked on the background in brown paint, and here and there vertical lines are drawn on the background. Brown, green and blue tones predominate, a lush manner of painting.
29d14ce628a8a87a4295fcdcc6b3e24c617aa631: In a room with grayish-white walls and a floor painted brown, a girl in a long pink dress is playing the violin. Lace at the neckline of the dress and at the ends of the wide sleeves reaching to the elbows. The girl's satiny hair is gathered at the nape of the neck. On the right a music stand resembling an easel with a sheet music book, above which part of a picture in a gilded frame can be seen on the wall.
5123fe74f6245cde2b6c3e49c8bf43de94d7ab0f: Over the entire surface of the picture, from top to bottom, a row of demonstrators is depicted tightly side by side: in the foreground a young fair-haired woman in a white blouse and a long reddish scarf, hands clenched into fists, mouth open; beside her a man in a blue suit in the same pose; behind them an older man in a hat, young men, two men holding red flags; behind them women and men in light-coloured headscarves.
9a4677eb573ed93cde7a0f305efb83a0f96a2df3: A stage-set landscape: in the foreground on the left a flowerbed with bushes trimmed into cone shapes, around the middle one a hedge and large pink flowers. To the left of a park path leading into the depth of the picture, a straight row of regularly trimmed bushes; to the right of the path a fragment of landscape with junipers painted onto a large rectangle. In the rear wall of the space a green forest, on the ceiling a cloudy sky is depicted.
d4586ad4ec4efe62e92e0777841cfdaef67dc3a0: In the foreground a large yellowish-green box, above which on the left coloured patches and lines, on the right an open book with reproductions. On the horizon a painting depicting a panorama of Tallinn, with a harbour in the foreground. The background in the lower part is dark blue with white pastose patches, above it uniformly light blue. Painted in places using a splattering technique, in places pastosely.
1f519e1fb00679e5132e44354a259e9ce3625c40: In the centre, Christ riding a grayish-white donkey. His figure in profile, head turned looking back over his left shoulder. Wearing a greenish robe. Both in front of and behind Christ, groups of people accompany and greet him. In the back on the right, a depiction of a city. The people in front of the city hold small palm branches in their hands. In the back on the left, brown mountains, a large tree in the centre.
c0e08c9c7dae3935cd71ff234798d4d87e280e03: The composition is built on a field with an arched upper part. A wide, diagonal plane of foaming water flows through it. In front, on the shore, two running figures - a woman with flowing hair and garments and, following her, a man, his left hand outstretched ready to grasp; his right hand raised above his head with a sword. Above the arch, in the upper left and right corners, two depictions of flasks.
9c83f3fc4df1d2826b2b6fa0596f499f3b667c29: Sailboats and horsemen on the shore. A low sandy beach. The sea is full of foam-crested waves. Seven sailboats with furled sails in the shallow coastal water. On the left a further solitary sailboat. In the middle, in shallow water, two horsemen. The left-hand horse with its side to the viewer. The horseman has a green saddlecloth and a dark yellow coat. The other horseman has a bright yellow coat.
b2b44da1adc03f5b9af6d55e56fe296fb2630f6a: World championship bronze medallist and 1924 Olympian Noormägi was the first athlete with a disability from Estonia to reach the Olympics. Namely he was deaf-mute (Eesti Spordileht: "Deaf-mute, he neither hears nor speaks, but nevertheless a fine weightlifter!"), who came to sport thanks to Georg Lurich. Lurich indeed visited the Vändra school for the deaf-mute precisely at the time when Noormägi was studying there.
71355dccfc758f2ee2e88758046b5978092c71ea: Hille Palm studied from 1957 to 1962 at the Tartu Art School and afterwards at the Estonian State Art Institute, which she graduated from in 1972. Her work focuses on the expressive depiction of the female body and emotions. Palm has participated in international exhibitions and received several awards, including the Kristjan Raud Prize in 1985.
82e023c0bdcf14bc396d79997b5c03bd0fcf08ad: Eero Ijavoinen graduated from Tallinn Pedagogical University as an art teacher (1992) and has taught at Paide Ühisgümnaasium and at Tartu Higher Art School. Ijavoinen paints and makes figures. His paintings resemble abstractions derived from landscapes, and his sculptures are made from wood and found objects. Ijavoinen has been exhibiting since 1988.
e0bf5356af6840753bb613bdb4e803d66e9a2eb6: Bust portrait of an older bearded man in a slight turn to the right, in pastel beige, blue and green tones. The man has a hooked nose, a slightly receding hairline, the right side of his face lightly lit. Both the portrait, the clothing and the background are painted as a combination of differently coloured patches, where the patches of colour are sometimes side by side, sometimes blend into one another.
57b0c689756b05566adc065180fa89d98894a100: In the centre a large vessel with red and yellowish-red tulips, to its right a vase with narcissi. In the foreground below on the right a glass vase with red, yellow and pink chrysanthemums. On the left in the foreground a tin vessel with red tulips, in the background on the left yellow and white narcissi, behind them white calla lilies. Background of a whitish-gray interior wall with a window above on the right.
b3b2ad91585c52dc1bb1fa9b8d7f48997fb15be5: Bust portrait of a young man in a quarter turn to the right. Yellowish-brown hair, dark blue eyes and eyebrows, straight nose, sharply outlined dark red mouth. Green and light purple used in painting the face area, the ear purple. Clothing generally indicated, white collar precisely rendered and a dotted tie in green-orange tones. Background around the head purple.
b47690166d042e8fa2bb69ad8634c158053d5e9e: In the foreground, centre and right, a dense thicket of sharp-tipped plants in dark tones reminiscent of reeds. In the lower right corner the bow of a boat pushed into the reeds. On the left edge electric blue sea, stones and beach sand. In the middle of the work a large bush painted delicately in blue and green tones. The sky mainly whitish-yellow, with restless clouds.
3e7693882184ba6d88f882659e5cc5f13f0f7ef9: In the foreground a richly laid table. In front a black and white shot bird, a ceramic vessel with a handle (decorated with ornaments); a pumpkin, from which a cut slice lies on the table. Behind the pumpkin a basket with grapes and grapevines. In front of the basket on the right three peaches, dark plums and a small bunch of grapes hanging over the edge of the table. Background evenly brownish.
f62131e1166a2a9b4ed6728bd0a8bfbff36c705a: A handsome young man (half-figure) in frontal view with open hands, long light brown curly hair, short beard and moustache, wearing a long pale red robe falling in folds with long sleeves, blue drapery over the left shoulder and waist. In the upper arch, between two golden cross marks, a golden inscription: TULGE KÕIK MINU JUURE KES TEIE KOORMATUD JA VAEVATUD (inscription unclear)
527a0621262063dc779fb6f766d8262e37f302db: On a regular store shelf stand dozens of different mass-product goods in rows. The conceptual displacement of the work lies in the fact that the artist has swapped the brand names familiar to the consumer on the packaging: for example, the shelf includes Marlboro shampoo, Snickers canned fish, Pedigree cornflakes, Omo muesli, Ariel lemonade, Nokia Coca-Cola, Coca-Cola ketchup, etc.
1cb609862dc8d016a402c2107e118e3222a002c9: In the foreground a horseman of the Order of the Sword Brothers. Behind the horse, tied by a strap to the rider's saddle, three captured Estonians. In the foreground a woman with a strap around her neck and her hands tied behind her back. The German horseman threatens them with a spear. At the back on the left a group of knights, stolen goods on a spare horse. At the back on the right, against the background of a spruce forest, a farmstead is burning.
93f67498eae058dae36db69962da526e887a66d7: Alexandre Valetto (1996) is a Russian-Italian artist. He studied in the sculpture and installation department at the Estonian Academy of Arts. In 2018 he studied architecture and urban planning at the Università Iuav di Venezia in Italy. He has participated in four group exhibitions and worked as a stage designer at the I Land Sound festival. He works as a VFX artist and jewellery artist.
27915ca5a343e3f546fb8940f2d7d818e034a13b: Margus Tiitsmaa (b. 1963), also known as Sorge, has had a long and colourful artistic path. During the Soviet era he studied in the art department of the pedagogical institute, worked as a window designer for a department store, and secretly performed performances in the Saue grove. He was not accepted to ERKI, because Sorge's mindset in every sense went beyond the standards and did not fit within the framework of traditional art education.
7e57ec4582ca0754ec9c131a8559e340d4ff8c04: On a black background, in the centre, a young woman standing in half-profile to the left, with long hair, in a white floor-length dress, holding grain stalks in her left hand. In the middle left a wooden slat garden gate and a crescent moon sickle; on the right, below, three light-coloured crosses vertically next to a wide white vertical stripe. On the right, in the middle, a grey rectangle horizontally, above it another crescent moon sickle.
68ee1faaf563b5f7ef7f20fac492bdd6e4bd1de0: On an even light blue background, brightly coloured links of abstract shapes — 3 dusty pink, 1 yellow, 1 dark green, 2 light green, 1 black, 1 red, 2 white, ochre — interwoven with one another chain-like. The links are irregular — round, angular, depicted flatly with zigzag edges. Decorative, vigorous painting style, in places impasto.
209c4a2f59c7ccab68d7b8609c407362965914bb: Cross-section of a bus-like vehicle. On the right, at the wheel, stands a yellowish male figure, behind him sit in a row a blue female figure and two more smaller, indistinct figures. Bravura-expressive painting technique. Bright patches of colour on a predominantly blackish-grey surface, golden and silver zigzag lines painted with a broad brush, streaks of flowing paint.
b677d3a674a6468e6c44704eefc3b5cc0b1b83b0: By the railway, against the background of a railway carriage, left of centre a woman's 3/4 figure slightly turned to the right. Red skirt and headscarf, green blouse. In her raised left hand a video camera, in her right an automatic weapon. In the background, against a light blue sky, two horsemen crossing the railway, the first with a red flag in hand, the one behind with a raised sword. Deliberately clumsy painting style.
b608f2fe06c4e52cdae433cfa11da8fcc103a153: Portrait of a woman with a reddish glowing face: wearing an ochre-coloured blouse with a triangular neckline, small eyes and mouth, hair falling straight down her back. Between the fingers of her raised right hand she holds a white cloth slightly above her head, falling onto her hands and shoulders. Her left hand supports the edge of the cloth wrapped around her shoulder. Background in greenish and grey tones.
cfc60b9d2de578305d4db4f9a5607c57f15ae289: A dark streak on the horizon, a purple-greenish calm sea with a lone white stone in the right golden section and a pinkish sandbank ridge in the left golden section and on the right edge. In the foreground, the sea floor exposed by the receded water, yellowish-pinkish-greenish, with occasional puddles and stones, entirely covered with sharp aquatic plants. Light blue sky with shapeless cumulus clouds.
35486532c7b3f0e57cc59572f3050fa19a166f12: Zigzag and curved-edged, flat, interlocking coloured shapes surrounded by an even black and white outline. From top to bottom on the left, in order: yellow, light green, light grey, red; on the right pink, black, dark green, light yellow, dark blue surface. Between and above them, arranged in steps, a white shape with a black outline.
e99df9c1dc184b5be2d246f17cc50e2f45dd7920: In the upper part, the face and shoulders of Võllamäe Pääru. Hair long, in strands, face with strong regular lines expressing concentrated anger: furrowed eyebrows, flared nostrils, tightly compressed mouth. With both hands he has grabbed the gun and bayonet of the soldier attacking him. The soldier in the lower left corner, back turned. Behind, bright flames of fire in the night.
e6e92a752eb23e48faf97fe75f414816886ea70e: In the left corner the artist's own head with a bare crown, viewed towards the right, cut off at shoulder height. Behind, a street crossing, a square with trees, a coachman, tiny figures. The street curves further away, towards the church and towers. The painting is densely worked through, plasticity emphasised in the portrait, in the middle ground the pattern of tree branches plays an important role.
20472973a829b19ffda90344c7449b0ec28c931a: The painting surface is divided by diagonal lines into three parts. In the central section, a horse adorned with golden hair, pulling a cart through a garlanded honorary gate, in which sit a sturdy woman and man dressed in Setu costume. Behind and beside them, people and a horse are visible. On the right part of a log wall, a conventional depiction of a standing Setu man with a scythe in hand. On the left a white horse seen from behind, harness lying on the ground.
b0fe738254e1393cb9bf175e6bdeb2f9a67bc8dd: View of Keila-Joa manor house. In the foreground grass and a park path. On the grass on the left a nanny sits with a child, a married couple stands. A young man leans against a tree reading a book. In the middle the Keila River. Across the river a stone water mill with a dam. Behind it a slightly taller stone building. The tower of the manor chapel rises above the other buildings. In the background on the left the main manor building with a tower, on which a flag flies.
671d0599e1104ae9dd4fd24f755657e97a8de660: From the 1980s he spent most of his summers painting and drawing in Haapsalu, his studio was located on Võnnu Street. He designed the building of the Gardening-Beekeeping Society located on the border of Haapsalu and Uuemõisa. This period also includes a series in a romantic vein done in the drypoint technique on the history of Haapsalu, several of which found an owner through the exhibition-sales of the Kivilill Gallery.
40f39d5b1576a2718c78dd5386bfadf18da119f0: who in his Tärkma workshop made instruments from the kannel to the double bass. I don't know whether it's a nice legend, or whether it's true that at one time he made so many mandolins that every school on Hiiumaa had a mandolin ensemble. The series originally consisted of 21 works from different villages of Hiiumaa that are important to me, the people and the birds and animals are all connected to Hiiumaa.
81d620653a464fbdc69328b561720df571f2d387: He created numerous wood sculptures. He developed a distinctive wood-burning technique and used it to finish almost all of his wooden works. Another favourite material was Saaremaa dolomite, from which he made garden sculptures. In his later life he experimented with many different materials — plaster, cement, epoxy resin, aluminium, bronze, aluminium, etc.
78e5087d6dfe8a6b3aa36aef27a4f81e53149995: Two riders on white horses: the left-hand rider naked, the right-hand one wearing a dark blue shirt and a white hat. To the right of the riders a woman in a purplish-pink dress and a dark shawl, with a brown basket in her hand and a white long-haired dog at her feet. In the background dark green trees and a threatening cloudy sky. Painted pastel-toned, with soft transitions.
a573127eb2287178592a3e581b1b64178eaf42ea: In the foreground, on a table covered with a bluish-grey cloth with ironed folds, one egg with a small crack and another with a broken shell, the yellow contents flowing out. To the right of the broken egg a sharp knife with a red-and-yellow striped handle and a tall cylindrical glass. Background dark, with smooth transitions from a dirty greyish-blue to brown tone.
9181a576dc92db905c7e1657a7090103d52a7e3d: In the foreground, in the centre, a small river flowing into the depth of the picture. By the river on the left a tiny house with a red roof, with large old trees, and a larger house with a brown roof and white chimney. To the right of the river bushes, in the background pastures and a strip of forest. Above, the sky densely covered with greyish clouds. Painted in muted green and yellow tones.
dd747e6e10e0fc9583adbf6d6ff9a2389ae34979: Three women sit on a riverside parapet: the outer ones in blue dresses in a chin-in-hand pose, the middle one in an orange dress with both hands resting palms-down on the parapet. In front of the right-hand woman a green urn with small handles. In the background a river and a hillside densely covered with stone houses. Painted in light blue and yellowish tones, modelling the forms as facets.
a5fb4f5db222ae5cee72df3bda20ed4ae45cf90f: A composition with cyclists divided into three horizontal colour planes. Green surfaces of different tones are separated by dark blue lines: on the middle plane the full figures of two female cyclists on blue wheels, on the lower plane two large lily blossoms and the bodies of three male cyclists framed from the shoulders and legs, hands on the handlebars of blue bicycles.
9eb384e0d8e66719bc043fefd679c0ffbd08deba: A night scene, with a dark sky and sea surface as background. Light falls from the right side. On the left a man in a long robe explains something with outstretched arms. He is being listened to by an Order knight sitting on a horse and a monk in a floor-length robe standing next to the horse. Deep black shadows fall from them. In the background to the right a German troop with pikes. To the front left fall the shadows of the pikemen.
004a479c6dac143dc6873a9c08e44ddb0cd3a920: Anna Kaarma graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a degree in graphic design and contemporary art. Her most used media are spatial installation, photography and video, book design and graphic design. Through her personal experience, Kaarma explores the Lasnamäe district in Tallinn, highlighting its different layers of meaning.
fb6913a9c7f7d436375592ed693d1b3d8adaf0f4: In the foreground a semi-reclining female nude, left arm raised around the head. To the right of the nude's legs, a portrait of a woman with beautiful wavy shoulder-length hair, a straight nose and brown eyes. Above the reclining nude on the left an over-life-size upper part of a face with two eyes and the line of a nose. In the background facets seemingly breaking into one another. A pastel greenish-grey-pink colour range.
a36f3f6fee82b7864ada18f8bbfb3160cbe157e3: In the foreground at the bottom a parapet imitating almost blackish-grey marble. On the parapet, to the left and right, abstract spatial forms. In the centre a red jagged flash strikes the marble, and from the point of impact a colourful bundle of rays bursts out at a 90-degree angle. On the parapet, at a distance of about 1/4 of the picture's width from the right edge, a small sky-blue glossy ball.
f32422d6f91f04d661787e30fa98f1a6f87aaace: In the foreground, painted with strong brushstrokes in impasto, a tree in white blossom, to the right of which a woman bends over, wearing a pink blouse, a blue skirt and a headscarf. In the middle ground a house with an extension and an outbuilding, in the background other houses to the left, above them a sky in clouds. In the foreground three plant clumps supported by sticks project beyond the edge of the picture.
d26de109665aaeb342ce29ba2842e0efe0908dc4: On a table covered with a pink cloth, rendered in inverted perspective, a round metal tray with three large yellow and three small red fruits. The yellow fruits are reflected on the metal surface of the tray. Behind the tray also a metal jug with an elegant line, with a knobbed lid. Background in bluish-lilac tones, the brushwork clearly showing through.
6168cd3aa00a2e1dc63b8026015dd1bd5cdc433f: A man over middle age standing with legs apart, right hand on hip, in a three-quarter turn to the right. The man has a wrinkled elongated face, a serious gaze directed straight ahead, dark hair combed straight back. Under the blue jacket a reddish shirt is visible, dark trousers, footwear. The upper part of the background is intense cobalt blue, at the bottom left a pile of bricks can be discerned. An angular manner of depiction.
25846cc5f151d518f7b04bebea632591ec060b3d: A composition consisting of an eyeless, dissolving-figured ochre-coloured woman and a pink, one-eyed man. Both have a white rectangle held in an outstretched hand's palm. In front of the pink figure a construction consisting of three arches. From the left edge a hand reaches into the picture. In the background brown mounds shaped like anthills, above them a bright blue sky.
7e09183a187ccd54f45017e8911a2b3a9335c24f: A knee-length figure of a long-haired, dark-complexioned young woman. Her left hand grasps a branch located higher up, the right reaches in the same direction; the whole figure in half-profile to the right. The woman wears a red national headdress, a red embroidered national blouse and a dark-toned skirt with an apron and a belt with metal ornaments and a large buckle. The background is given sketchily, not covering the whole canvas surface.
cb21e831e418665ac1f9a01f9bd9389203fd1919: In the foreground, against a background of a snowy winter landscape, a cylindrical fluted pedestal from which hands rise holding cameras and stone fragments, the hand in the middle holding an apple, above it a smaller hand with a woven basket. The background consists of horizontal black and white stripes, on the white ones a row of black dots which grow larger in size as they rise.
c5e8b43871f65d372df9c3f896f5949ebcd14f85: A black-and-white winter photograph printed on satin fabric, showing an abandoned outdoor pool area in Kadriorg. The surroundings of the pool and the stand are covered with snow, the pool walls bear graffiti and the bottom is entirely filled with embroidered sparkling tube-shaped beads. The work belongs to the author's set of works "Basseinid" ["Pools"], the bachelor's thesis defended in graphic art at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2005.
bb8998104ed85d3a70006c049c6c7ec09639df7e: A view of a coastal farm situated on a sloping bank. On the left, between low pines, the end of a building with a red gable roof is visible. To the right of it, between pole fences, a low greyish house surrounded by trees and bushes. In the distance to the right a winding bay. The sky is bright, with greenish-blue clouds. Painted vigorously in bluish and beigish-green tones.
9e99b9f1b53560a382c74d63b336517006af5d1b: A southern landscape in yellow and green tones: in the middle ground on the right a bright house with a low roof, balconies and an arcade. In front of the house the upper part of an antique column. Behind the house a lake or bay, from whose shores low mountains rise to the horizon. In the upper right corner part of a house is visible, on the left in the middle ground a number of slender cypresses and the ruins of an aqueduct.
6b1a4cf03439acb0aa4f83b72798b22be571df36: In the foreground below, part of a building with a staircase and pinkish-red balcony parapets. A telescope is attached to the balcony. From the balcony a view opens onto an ice field, at whose edge ice floes have piled up. In front of the ice floes, groups of people gathered on the ice watching sailing boats. Above the horizon a romantic sky in light blue and pink tones, with a few clouds with broken edges.
23ba6ff26bf3a43eb3546dbfd002ab6b5dead0be: In an indoor interior, in the foreground on the left a man sits facing forward, wearing a light shirt and a dark waistcoat. In his right hand, resting in his lap, a glass. He stares from under his brows. In front of him a potted plant. Further back on the right a woman in a pinkish trouser suit sits on a sofa, one leg over the other, her head turned in half-profile to the right. Painted with lush brushstrokes in dark, purplish-blackish tones.
068be8804da3ca500a01a5bafba055c9c6e9513e: A broad landscape view: in the foreground a ploughed field in yellowish and reddish-brown tones, behind it in the middle a birch grove and isolated groups of trees to the left and right of it. On the horizon a bluish-green strip of forest, above which a bright blue sky in yellow and pink tones is rendered with small low clouds. A dense, choppy brush technique.
40f2303374054e3879b0f1a2913a3fc2742f9315: In a night setting, five young women in leather clothing in front of a dark Ford. In the foreground two heavily made-up women crouch. In the middle, in front of the car, stands a woman with reddish hair, hands on the fender. Further back, sitting on the car's bonnet, two women, the one on the left wearing a short skirt. The others wear long black trousers. Each woman's name is written next to her in silver marker.
8d7158c6f4e424cb8d5630ec807afdb3262fe19f: A lithographer, photographer and businessman active in Tartu from 1857-1875, originally from Germany. In 1857 he acquired the former G. F. Schlater lithography workshop in Tartu. He published views of Tartu and other prints, produced portraits and group pictures, and made much use of photolithography. L. Höflinger's photography studio was located in Tartu, on Promenaadi Street (in the Sukoffsky house).
0f903609943a1af2d0ac3bcfbb2ffa515e0be84e: Kristel has graduated from the art school of Toila Gymnasium, and taken painting reproduction as an additional subject at the University of Tartu. She loves to draw and paint people, and also experiments with animal portraits. She draws every day and tries out new techniques and possibilities for herself. Alongside painting she works at the Vanemuine theatre, where her occupation is as a singer in the opera choir.
99e80e17fecd324dbc3dacef446baa18b5263cb3: A five-figure composition. On the left, against the background of a green log house, a girl in profile facing right, dressed in white, with a brochure in her hand. On the right edge a curly-haired young man with a jacket thrown over his shoulders, in half-profile to the left. The background a hilly landscape with houses and haystacks. Large round colour planes, in places toning the figures, in the centre of the composition.
72a050c06f3d67f2d382f0e78131dfc2605027cd: A grand panoramic construction landscape with a glowing sky and black smoke clouds. In the foreground a balance of horizontal and vertical rhythms achieved through the emphasis of cranes and scaffolding. In the foreground below a long unfinished building with a dark red wall. In a colour range of pink, dark red and black. In places painted in impasto and with a palette knife.
8af851e43e09fa554f44f35f7aad4c8e1b23f5fe: In the foreground on a brown table, in a large glass jar, a bouquet of dried flowers and grasses, to the left of which a small glass bottle with a dried flower. On the right a green glass fruit vase with a red rose; behind it a tall, angular bottle narrowing at the top, with a dried stalk. At the bottom edge a glass vessel and a red rose. Background greenish-blue on the right, brownish on the left.
32663af421da4cd7924fdb13be82ea0447f934e5: A male figure on an inclined surface descending on skis. Arms slightly bent, wearing ski boots and skis fastened with straps, a collared ski jumper and tracksuit trousers, on his head an old-fashioned Estonian men's leather winter hat, with earflaps fastened behind that hang freely. It has been toned in terracotta colour, the toning having faded to a lighter shade.
4c76000c033fbf76f69abff11d2274aaba4d56cc: The Neoclassical main building of the University of Tartu viewed from the corner of Ülikooli Street. In front of the university, mostly uniformed students are moving about. On the roadway a two-horse carriage with an officer. A dog runs in front of the horses. On the left in the foreground three students. On the right a gentleman and lady crossing the road. In the distance the houses of Jaani Street and the tower of St John's Church with a clock.
6e8ceac0327be10a89338e8ad6ba77728296946f: Mati Kütt (b. 1947 in Tallinn) is a painter and animated film director. In 2001–2002 he worked in America, in Denver, the capital of the state of Colorado, as a lecturer in experimental animation at the Rocky Mountain College of Art and Design. Kütt is a member of the Estonian Filmmakers' Union (1985), the Estonian Artists' Association (1999) and the Estonian Painters' Association (1999).
e666c4f96bc6a0c5c6292bb919c7057a036ddf64: (Ants Murakin's brother) Karl Murakin had studied painting under A. Laikmaa. As an amateur artist he belonged to the first, older generation of the Viljandi cultural centre's art circle. His painterly oeuvre stands out for a mastery approaching professional level. The artist had an excellent command of impressionistic colour treatment and realistic form.
d9740a6b8e8dd4187e2a5a4efe219425cc9f4e91: Ede Raadik (b. 1989) is a Tallinn-based artist who defended her master's degree in 2015 in the Graphic Art department of the Estonian Academy of Arts. She mostly works in the series format typical of conceptualist art. In doing so she uses photography to demonstrate how we often (mis)interpret visual information. In the extensive series
7347aa9dd51098e0a2fa26529b1e82642d78be8b: Ahti Seppet (b. 1953 in Tartu) is mainly known as a sculptor and a master of sculptural installations, but has also practised painting and printmaking. Seppet graduated in 1973 from the Tartu Art School in the specialty of artistic wood design. He has participated in exhibitions since 1978 (as a painter). Since 1990 Seppet has been a member of the Artists' Association.
d27910734e92c3f2fc88e75a815589db9dab2bc5: A two-part composition. Tar paper and a rusted sheet-metal base (upper left, lower right) fastened to a robust upright wooden frame, on which a swastika-like propeller shape composed of two bent arms and two legs is marked in white paint. The background is painted in silver, bronze and reddish colour. A saw blade is fastened between the two parts.
fc909a452a57f90a2cdb380b93a8a0b90eb0998a: The work consisted of two parts: a) floating a glass cube from April to October 1994 (actions, performances); b) a video installation in Brazil, at the São Paulo Biennial. The documentary video depicts the floating of a large mirrored cube on the Emajõgi River and the Vltava River in Prague. The glass cube reflects water, sky, flashing trees, people, arched bridges.
535291e02ccd99cfa533b7a44351988d998ed9cf: Half-figure of a bearded man turned to the right, rendered in light, at times extensive patches of colour, avoiding contours in the process. The body in a grey shirt projects more plastically from the background, since the hands are merged with the background. Yellow and pink dominate around the head, contrasted by blue, green and purple in the face area. Golden frame moulding.
a45f7673178c146ce5a5cc734b1cac0c96877d10: Summer view of a farmyard. In the middle left a cross-log barn with a partly bare thatched roof. The barn door is open. The dwelling house situated further right in the background is in a light brownish colour scheme. In the distance gates and a garden. In the right foreground a tall well sweep. The background is a cloudy summer sky. In the foreground centre a dusty road. On the right and left a fieldstone fence can be seen.
1b538d571bd2f288577d8e0aa3974b27991a2d81: Panorama of restoration works in central Tartu. In the foreground the slope of Aia Street, where rubble is being cleared and removed, and trees are being planted along the street with the help of a lifting mechanism. Further away on the hillside many people at work, against the background of houses situated further back. On the left side of the picture, the tower of St John's Church with its helm roofs can be seen above the roofs, together with the town hall.
8f2c8262e5df3264f4b8c218420f5cc48214a452: In the vault of the sky a bald female nude hovers, wearing red high-heeled shoes and holding a wine glass. Above her a reddish heavenly vault opens with angels. The nude is observed by sickly figures in pink robes standing at both edges of the painting, between whom smoking industrial building chimneys appear. In the lower edge of the painting, figures in reddish and purple tones are depicted drinking and smoking.
9a14126d29f90ea43307ad9ec65049e004833379: Martin Vällik's (1970) first solo exhibition took place at the University of Tartu Library in 1989, but his interest in astronomy, which began in childhood, started reaching his photographs from the 2010s onward. Martin Vällik works daily as a physics teacher at the Tallinn English College. He is a member of the Estonian Physical Society, the Estonian Astronomical Society and the Estonian Artists' Association.
8e06314c1c24e54ed4c386df69e6f04a6acf7b7e: On the sheet, left and right, three rectangles each, between them vertically three narrower rectangles. In the upper one, on a black background, a female nude (three-quarter figure), hands behind the neck; in the middle one the same figure half-undressed between red vertical lines; in the lower one within a black frame. The side rectangles are bordered alternately with black, then red, etc. contour lines.
0e37b3043a142b4c628cc09e2d2e5491956ec6c3: In the foreground a partly lit courtyard corner with grayish shadow stripes, bounded on the right by a grayish-brown plank fence and on the left by part of a single-storey stone building with a colonnade of curved arches. In the middle of the yard a pump well. Behind the fence part of a red tiled roof with a light-coloured edge can be seen, and further away, against a light sky background, the tower helms of three churches.
6368d5038cec4cc923df699773742e88b48dddfa: In the foreground a woman sitting in a dark skirt and dark patterned blouse, a green shawl on her shoulders. A brooch at the blouse's neckline, a beige hat on her head, her face brightly lit beneath it. To the woman's right, on a windowsill, on a striped cloth, a light-coloured vase with colourful fruits. On the left striped curtains, in the background a window with a view of a light blue sky and the city.
9c2dca3db6da795665e54df10afdf4dbfe0a1e19: On a sandy beach people are busy by a fish crate, on the right on the shore of a light-grey sea women and men around boats, to their left four figures with some tool, further back people by fish sheds, to the left a horse with a cart. Light colour scheme: grayish, ochreish, occasional reddish and bluish accents, greenish tufts of grass in the foreground.
49b2955b2ed0babbc3c67532b0d56cc201e8aa5b: Mountainous Crimean landscape: in the right foreground a patterned stone street parapet and exposed boulders, on and among which trees grow. Leaning on the parapet, a panoramic view opens on the left of forested low mountains, given in the distance as a bluish mountain massif. Above the mountains white cloud banks, above a light blue sky.
c4cbe6502a5ffdd949f65954c216def68d00b183: On the left half of the composition, a half-figure of a young woman with long straight brown hair, sitting in a Neo-Baroque armchair with yellow upholstery, her upper body slightly turned to the right, wearing an orange open-necked jumper with brownish-red shadows. In front, on the right, on a blue table, a pinkish clay jug. The background of the right-hand part - geometric colour planes.
9aa87e6743b506bb31555c6a101a7a866688ca1d: In the centre a record with the inscription "HIS MASTER'S VOICE", information about the record and an image of a dog listening to a gramophone. From the record a hand extends, pointing to an arm below the record clenched into a fist with a twisted cord and a stick, another hand on the left pointing in the same direction. In the background a domed landscape with lake eyes and a sky with blue clouds.

03a4937afb49f8cae25b95eb53cd58f34fe181ae: A mature summer landscape in a muted silver-grey colour palette: in the centre, to the right of the vertical midline, a path leading up a hill.
